# DeepSeek Harness Game Studios

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.6-orange.svg)
![Agents](https://img.shields.io/badge/agents-49-purple.svg)
![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-76-green.svg)
![Hooks](https://img.shields.io/badge/hooks-14-orange.svg)
![Rules](https://img.shields.io/badge/rules-13-blue.svg)
![Port of CCGS](https://img.shields.io/badge/port%20of-CCGS%20v1.1.2-lightgrey.svg)

[![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.md) [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.zh-CN.md)

[Install](#install) · [Implementation status](#implementation-status) · [Project structure](#project-structure) · [Testing your customizations](#testing-your-own-customizations) · [Verification](#verification) · [License](#license)

Turn a single DeepSeek Harness session into a full game development studio.
**49 agents. 76 skills. One coordinated AI team.**

This is a **port of [Claude Code Game Studios](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios) (CCGS)**
to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — not a rewrite from scratch: the skills, agents, rules and docs come from
upstream (MIT); this repository provides the DSH-native runtime (Node hooks, skill generation,
machine-level install, plugin bridge).

## Provenance

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream project | [`Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios`](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios) |
| Upstream version this port tracks | **v1.1.2** (commit `b21fa0f`, 2026-09-29) |
| Upstream license | **MIT** (Copyright © 2026 Donchitos) — reused here |
| This repository | `deepseek-harness-game-studios` (DSGS) **v0.1.4** |
| Port strategy | Dual stack, one source: `.claude/` is the content source (upstream text, kept verbatim); `.dsh/**` is generated by `tools/build-dsh.mjs` |

Upstream targets Claude Code (`.claude/`, `.sh` hooks, `bash` one-liners, `@path` imports). None of that
runs under DSH (no `bash` tool, piped child processes are denied by the sandbox, `@path` is not expanded),
so instead of editing upstream content we generate a DSH-runnable equivalent and prove **no content loss**.

> This repository **is the plugin package**. The framework it installs is bundled under `payload/` — you never need to look at it.

## Install

### ① GUI

`Plugins` → `Add plugin` → paste `https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios` → **Install** → **restart `dsh web`**.

### ② Command line

```pwsh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
```

Then **restart `dsh web`**.

On first load the plugin installs the framework at machine level (`~/.dsh/dsgs` plus user-level
bootstrap skills). After that:

```
new working directory → new session → type /start
```

`/start` checks whether the workspace is initialised; if not it initialises it first, then walks you
through onboarding.

## What the plugin writes to your machine (and how to undo it)

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `~/.dsh/dsgs/**` | framework payload (skills, agents, rules, hooks, tools, docs, instruction files) |
| `~/.dsh/skills/dsgs-init/SKILL.md`, `~/.dsh/skills/start/SKILL.md` | user-level bootstrap skills |

It never touches a project directory and never overwrites project files. To undo:

```pwsh
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsgs"
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\dsgs-init","$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\start"
# then uninstall the plugin and restart dsh web
```

## Implementation status

### ✅ Implemented (all measured)

| Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Skills | ✅ | all 74 upstream skills ported, each invocable as `/name` |
| Agent role cards | ✅ | 49, as `.dsh/agents/<name>.md` + delegation conventions |
| Rules | ✅ | 13, including an equivalent for upstream's path-scoped rule engine: a PostToolUse hook injects the matching rule text after each write/edit |
| Hooks | ✅ | 12 upstream scripts → 14 Node rewrites, bridged via `dsh-hooks-claude-code`; all 9 upstream events covered |
| Hooks actually run | ✅ | mount 10/10 · protocol 12/12 · live events 6/9 |
| Config resolution | ✅ | `project.yaml` single source; Node ports of `resolve_config` / `__call resolve_setting` |
| Helper scripts | ✅ | every upstream `.sh` has a Node port (`.dsh/scripts/*.mjs`) that runs inside the sandbox |
| Content fidelity | ✅ | 258 files / 42,895 lines: 96.0% verbatim, 3.1% documented rewrites, 0.5% structural, 0.4% fuzzy, **0 unexplained loss** |
| Machine-level install | ✅ | the plugin ships the payload and installs it on first load; `/start` initialises an empty workspace (measured: 928 items) |
| `/statusline` | ✅ | studio status line `stage · posture · epic > story · Sprint n/m · engine` (+13 unit tests) |
| Nested delegation | ✅ | `subagent.maxDepth: 2` — parent → child → grandchild verified (DSH default is 1) |
| One-package install | ✅ | one package = hook bridge + status line projection + payload self-install |
| DSGS-only skills | ✅ | `statusline`, `dsgs-install` (not in upstream) |

### ❌ Not implemented / no equivalent (with reasons and substitutes)

| Item | Status | Why | Substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| Docked status bar above the composer | ❌ | DSH's client roster only lists `@deepseek-ai/*` packages (measured: 60+ entries, ours absent even with a `dsh.client` declaration) | `/statusline` skill + `node .dsh/statusline.mjs`; the runtime half (turns/tokens/cache/context %) is already covered by DSH's own status bar |
| Pre-action reminders on PreToolUse | ❌ | `tools/pre-execute` only carries `allow/deny/cancel/ask`; `additionalContexts` is read from the final tool result; `agent.inject()` mid-execution has no effect | `validate-commit` / `validate-push` are also registered on **PostToolUse** (reminder arrives after the action); set the plugin row `advisory: deny` to block before the action |
| 3 hook events cannot be triggered from a prompt | ⚠️ | `Notification`, `PreCompact`, `PostCompact` have no DSH event source | mapping implemented and unit-tested, verified at mount level only (live coverage 6/9) |
| Per-agent tool allowlists / agent auto-discovery | ❌ | DSH's `subagent` does not accept a per-agent tool set and has no agent registry | role cards + `toolFilter` / `persona` conventions |
| `@path` imports | ❌ | DSH does not expand imports | `.dsh/docs/studio-rules.md` (merged), read on demand |
| `!`cmd`` pre-execution lines | ❌ | DSH has no pre-execution | rewritten as a "prerequisite command" block the model runs itself |
| Byte-for-byte bash ↔ Node parity | ⚠️ | `python3` in this machine's Git Bash is a Store placeholder | 2 named SKIPs, 1 case byte-identical |

## Project Structure

```
.claude/                     # Upstream content source (MIT, kept verbatim)
  settings.json              # Hooks, permissions, safety rules
  agents/                    # 49 agent definitions
  skills/                    # 74 skills (one directory per skill)
  hooks/                     # 14 scripts — 12 event hooks + yaml-helper.sh
  rules/                     # 13 path-scoped coding standards
  statusline.sh              # Upstream status line (kept as reference)
  docs/                      # workflow catalog, 39 templates, guidance
.dsh/                        # Generated by tools/build-dsh.mjs — do not edit by hand
  agents/  skills/  rules/  hooks/  scripts/  docs/
tools/                       # Generator, verifiers, Node ports, plugin, installers
dsh-src/                     # Hand-written DSH-only overlay (merged into .dsh/)
DSGS Skill Testing Framework/  # QA for the skills and agents themselves
design/ src/ assets/ tests/ prototypes/ production/   # Your project
```

## Testing your own customizations

DSGS is a template you are meant to edit. `DSGS Skill Testing Framework/` is how you check that an
edited or newly written skill still holds up — a catalog of all skills and agents, per-category quality
rubrics, behavioral specs, and templates for writing specs of your own.

```
/skill-test static [name]     # structural linter
/skill-test category [name]   # category-specific quality rubric
/s

plugins.description: A 7x24 resident personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness: human-bound standing autonomy, self-wake across restarts, expiry-aware notices that stay silent unless they matter, and a read-only reach over every session, this machine and the person's work channels - it reads everything, drafts everything, and writes nothing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-den

> A **7×24 resident personal assistant** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh).
> Not another chat window — an assistant that stays on, keeps its own memory, works while you are away, and stops to ask before it acts outside your trust boundary.

Status: **the core is implemented, tested, and active in a real profile.** This line deliberately carries no test count: a hard-coded one rotted repeatedly (307, 309, 316, 319, 320, 322, 323, 326, 327 — each time while the suite was in fact green), and the last rot happened one round after a "fix". So the line states what is stable and `npm test` prints what moves. The plugin is loaded inside a real DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop profile — it is in that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the running host reports it as `fiberPhase: active` — registering 16 model-facing tools, the approval guard, the heartbeat, and an interactive status panel. Verified against the *running* system rather than only in tests: the heartbeat ticks on its 60-second cadence, and the panel is an **active occupant** of both `sidebar.panellist` (`id: dsh-den.status`, order 245) and the `main` panel (`key: dsh-den.status`) — read from the live browser page through the host's read-only Slot inspector, not from the plugin's own registration call.

**Those live sentences were re-established on 2026-10-14 against the instance reporting `startedAt: 2026-10-14T02:10:43.000Z`**, whose own freshness verdict is `known: true, stale: false` and which loaded this tree 1000 seconds after its last source edit. `npm run verify:live` exits 0 against it and **all seven live probes pass**: the heartbeat ticks on its 60-second cadence, the route answers, an agent **cannot** obtain standing autonomy from the live host, the approval gate is the only path to authority, the expiry rule works in the host's own directory, scenario isolation holds against the same store the host reads, and disk evidence shows the `den_*` tools really were invoked. The earlier instance, `08:43:05.676Z`, is why this paragraph exists: after the panel fix landed at `09:24:00` it was still serving the previous panel while six live probes went on printing passes — each one run on its own, and each one describing code that was no longer on disk. Two things now make that state impossible to report as a pass. The plugin reports `status.freshness`: the newest source edit beside it against its own start, computed per request rather than cached at boot, with "cannot tell" as its own answer instead of a healthy default. And every live probe script is chained behind `tools/require-fresh-host.mjs`, which refuses to run it when the instance is stale or cannot say.

**The panel change is verified by what the page asked for, not by pixels.** At `09:52:28` — 141 seconds after that boot — a `panel-autonomy-requested` event reached the route carrying a **real conversation id**, `session-95cc8a8d-…`. The previous panel had no conversation to pass (resolving the active session *was* the defect, and it passed `null`), and the host is confirmed to be running the new code, so only the dock can have sent it; the probe's own requests are identifiable by their literal session ids (`live-autonomy-probe`, `grant-bypass-probe`). Two independent facts — the host loaded this tree, and a request only the dock can make arrived — are firmer evidence than a screenshot, and a screenshot is still not claimed.

**The panel was taking most of the screen, and that was a design error rather than a layout one.** The dock above the message box rendered the entire self-check creation form — title, prompt, interval, submit — permanently. It was there for a reason: the dock is the one seat the shell hands a real conversation to, and `schedules/create` refuses without one, so the form had to live somewhere a conversation exists. But the *capability* needs a conversation; it does not need to be on screen. The dock is now one line of state — autonomy, its two controls, and a one-line `New` disclosure — and the empty state names the cheaper path: say «check CI every 30 minutes» in the conversation and the den adds it. That this is small is machine-checked rather than asserted: `tools/check-client-interaction.mjs` requires the dock to render **zero** inputs and no submit button until the disclosure is pressed (it rendered three inputs and a submit button before), then checks that the form still sends the same payload once opened. The logic is the one the reference assistants this project is measured against are built on — state at a glance, one thing at a time, and the human talks instead of filling in forms — stated as a reading rather than a quotation, because this plugin's own gate keeps `web_fetch` fail-closed in a profile with `approval: never`, so those pages were not readable from inside this session.

**The admitted wake happened — at the first heartbeat after the self-check came due.** On 2026-10-14 the panel minted a request, that token came back as a **human message**, and `den_set_autonomy` recorded `{ok: true, autonomy: true, boundToMessage: "b7b68b9f-…"}` for `session-95cc8a8d-…`. A self-check was then created with the 300-second floor; it came due at `02:34:26`, and the next tick — `02:34:43`, one cadence later — spent a turn and spoke: the ledger went `turns 0 → 1`, `spoken 0 → 1`, `notices 1`, and the trigger was consumed. The host recorded the event itself, `{"type":"wake-spoke","triggerId":"76e58cc0c47ef5…"}`, and `npm run drill:after` returned `RESULT: PASS` (exit 0) behind a guard that had just confirmed the instance loaded this tree. Three details make it more than one successful run. **The same call used to be auto-refused**: the gate audit still lists historical `den_set_autonomy → unknown-tool → ask` entries from the instance before the fix, and the successful call is absent from that list — it was classified as the den's own tool. That classification is the fix described in [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) §2.28–§2.30: the approval policy in this profile is not its own switch but a side effect of the permission preset (`danger-full-access` implies `approval: never`, where a gate `ask` means *never*, not *later*), so for a while every den tool that was not read-only was unreachable — memory, self-checks and authority alike. The answer was to classify den's own tools as its own, each with a stated bound, rather than to weaken the credential, shell and outbound rules above that table; those rules still refuse this session's own calls when they should. **The counters are read separately on purpose**: `turns` is charged after delivery and `spoken` only when the wake actually says something, so a wake that was admitted and judged not worth saying would have shown `turns 1, spoken 0` and failed the drill; both moved, so this was a wake that *spoke*. And **the grant is bound to a message**, not to a click: `boundToMessage` names the human message that carried the token. What is still only verified offline: a wake *after a restart*. Triggers, grants and the ledger all live on disk and survived the restart that moved this host to `02:10:43`; `test/cold-start.test.mjs` grants through the real token, stores a trigger, moves the clock past a restart and watches the wake fire — but the joined event (restart, then a wake) has not been observed live, and neither has its negative (a due trigger with no authority staying silent). Both need a human act, and `npm run drill:before` / `npm run drill:after` is how either would be measured. [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) §2.35 has the event chain and both gaps; §2.34 is the defect this drill found in itself the first time it ran for real.


**The wake spoke and nobody was told — the defect a reader of this panel found.** The page reported `Pending notices 1 / 1` and `Today's self-initiated turns 1` while the human had received nothing, and the strip above the message box still offered a **spent** token with the instruction to paste it. Both had the same shape of cause: a surface reporting state it had no way to update. `pendingNotices` knew only "deliverable" and "expired", so a notice that had been shown could not stop being pending — the count could nev

plugins.description: Per-request serving-intent hints for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the X-Agent-Hint HTTP header on an independent chat-completions provider route. Install: dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-hints

Per-request serving-intent hints for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): every main-line model request carries a structured **AgentHint on the `X-Agent-Hint` HTTP header** (UTF-8 JSON, base64url) — session identity, agent status, priority, and cache control — so a serving engine (your inference gateway) can observe and act on what the agent is doing, per the "agent signals, engine consumes" pattern.

The plugin registers an **independent provider route `deepseek-hint`** backed by its own chat-completions adapter. The official `deepseek-official` route stays mounted and remains the fallback; deployment switches via `agent-default-model.provider`. Zero harness source modification, zero harness runtime dependencies (cordis is touched as a structural duck type only).

English | [中文](README.zh.md) · Design notes: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) ([中文](docs/design.zh.md))

## How it works

The harness `LlmAdapter` contract is thin (only `stream()` is required), and the official adapter constructs its HTTP headers inside its `request()` implementation with no extension point. This plugin therefore ships a self-contained adapter that implements the contract structurally and adds one header:

```http
POST {baseURL}/chat/completions
authorization: Bearer …
content-type: application/json
x-deepseek-harness-session-id: session-…          ← identity signal, aligned with the official adapter
x-agent-hint: eyJzZXNzaW9uIjp7InNlc3Npb25faWQi…   ← base64url of a UTF-8 JSON AgentHint
```

The request body stays in the provider's original chat-completions format and **never carries hint fields**. To an endpoint that does not understand the header, it is a harmless unknown header.

This differs from static header-injection approaches (e.g. wrapping `fetch` to set fixed headers like a `user-agent`): here the hint value is **derived per request** from the session's durable event log (call index, compaction epoch, last tool result time) and the session lineage — there is nothing static to configure.

### Header emission rules

- **Main-line requests only**: auxiliary calls (`compaction`, `session-title` purposes) and requests without a session identity carry no hint.
- `strict_priority` is **never sent** by an agent (trusted-control-plane field).
- `prediction` is not sent in v1 (it requires an observation statistics engine).
- Session identity mirrors the official adapter: `x-deepseek-harness-session-id` (when a session id exists) and `x-deepseek-harness-compact: 1` (on compaction) are sent as-is.

### The `X-Agent-Hint` payload

```jsonc
{
  "session": {
    "session_id": "session-…",
    "agent_type": "agent",
    "call_index": 7,          // derived from the session's durable log (step/start count); restart-safe
    "epoch": 0                // derived from compaction/end count; restart-safe
    // "parent_session_id" / "derivation": {"relation": "spawn"|"fork", "join": "sync"|"async"} — lineage sessions only
  },
  "agent_status": { "state": "running", "state_since_ms": 1760000000000 },
  "priority": { "level": 3, "reason": "user_waiting" },          // configured; null omits
  "cache_control": [{ "type": "pin", "range": { "end": 1 } }]    // configured; null omits
}
```

Out-of-band status events (`tool` → `running` → `finalize` per working session, incl. awaited tool names and call ids) are reported to the optional `statusSink` (local JSONL file); the `emit()` seam is where a gateway client takes over.

## Install

Built JS is committed to this repository (`lib/`), so installing from GitHub needs **no build-script permission**:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints
```

Pin a commit for reproducibility: `dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints#<sha>`. An npm package (`dsh plugin add dsh-agent-hints`) is planned but not yet published.

## Configure and deploy

The plugin is inert until you point it at an upstream. Override the `agent-hints` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (later layers replace the row's entire `config` value, so restate every key you need):

```yaml
- id: agent-hints
  config:
    baseURL: https://your-gateway.example.com
    apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_KEY
```

Then switch the model route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: deepseek-hint
  model: deepseek-flash
```

The API key resolves per request: credentials service first (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` / Models page), then the environment variable named by `apiKeyEnv` — the same order as the official adapter.

### Configuration reference

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseURL` | string | — (required) | Upstream base; every chat request posts to `${baseURL}/chat/completions` |
| `apiKeyEnv` | string | — (required) | Environment-variable name resolved per request |
| `agentType` | string | `agent` | Reported as `session.agent_type` |
| `priority` | `{level, reason}` or `null` | `{level: 3, reason: "user_waiting"}` | Soft priority; `null` omits the field |
| `cacheControl` | array or `null` | `[{type: "pin", range: {end: 1}}]` | Cache control entries; `null` omits |
| `thinking` | `"enabled"` / `"disabled"` | enabled | `disabled` limits every conversation request to `off` |
| `reasoningEffort` | `"off"/"low"/"high"/"max"` | `high` | Default reasoning effort when a request carries none |
| `models` | `{id, name, contextWindow, maxTokens}[]` | DeepSeek-V4 family catalog | Advisory model catalog for `resolveModel`; **provide real limits when pointing at your own gateway** (they feed compaction decisions) |
| `defaultContextWindow` | positive integer | `1000000` | Context window assumed for models absent from the catalog |
| `defaultMaxTokens` | positive integer | `256000` | Per-request output cap materialized when callers omit one |
| `statusSink` | string | unset (channel off) | Local JSONL path for out-of-band status events |
| `subagentToolNames` | string[] | `["subagent"]` | Tool names treated as subagent delegation for `derivation.join` and status naming |

Invalid config aborts composition at load time with a field path — request-time hint construction has no failure path.

## Known limits (v1)

- Chat-completions wire only; subset: text + tools + thinking + usage + abort. Image/file content is rejected explicitly (`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`), never silently degraded.
- The protocol subset must be kept in sync with the official adapter manually (the deployment target is your own gateway, so the subset is under control).
- `call_index`/`epoch`/`state_since_ms` are derived from the session's event log and depend on harness event semantics (`step/start` precedes dispatch; auxiliary calls do not count as loop steps).
- `derivation.join` reads the parent's most recent delegating tool call — parallel delegations share the latest value (accepted approximation).
- Switching providers back to `deepseek-official` silently drops hints; the e2e wire assertions below are the safety net.
- **Always-thinking models**: the session-title auxiliary call forces `thinking: {type: "disabled"}` (official convention). Gateways backed by always-thinking models (e.g. `glm-5.3-flash` on Volcengine) reject it with an error; the harness tolerates the failure — the task itself is unaffected — but such sessions get no generated title. Prefer a model that supports thinking-off for auxiliary calls, or accept untitled sessions (verified on a real gateway: main-line requests with `thinking: enabled` + `reasoning_effort` are accepted, the task completes exit 0, and the hint header reaches the gateway).

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run build        # src/ → lib/ (built JS is committed)
npm test             # node --test against the built JS
e2e/run.sh           # keyless wire e2e: local SSE capture stub + hinted route + report assertions
```

The e2e resolves the `dsh` runtime from `DSH_BIN`, `PATH`, or a deepseek-harness checkout (`DSH_CHECKOUT` or the sibling directory).

## License

[MulanPSL-2.0](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable/disable skills by group (skill toggles manager)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-toggles

DeepSeek Harness 技能开关插件：**黑名单语义 + 分组**——所有技能默认可用，只有被"启用中的分组"显式禁用的才被过滤（生效黑名单 = 启用分组黑名单的并集）。全新安装、状态文件缺失或损坏都等于"全部启用"，永不出现"装上即全消失"。

![技能面板](assets/screenshots/panel.png)

## 安装

- **插件市场**：在 dshmarket 中搜索 `dsh-skill-toggles`，一键安装；
- **npm**：
  ```
  dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-toggles
  ```
- **本地源码**：
  ```
  dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<本仓库绝对路径>
  ```

安装后重启 DSH（浏览器半重新加载页面即可）。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skill-toggles`（`postuninstall` 自动删除状态目录 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-skill-toggles/`）。

## 使用

![分组管理](assets/screenshots/groups.png)

1. **打开面板**：聊天输入框工具条的「技能」按钮 → 左侧悬浮面板。
2. **分组**：内置默认分组（初始全开、可编辑、不可删除）；可新建/重命名/删除自定义分组，每组有自己的黑名单与启用开关——切换启用状态即整组生效/失效。
3. **技能列表**：每行开关作用于当前选中分组；支持搜索、按**来源分节**（插件包 / 用户 / 项目 / 自定义 / 其他，可折叠）与每节"全部禁用/全部启用"。技能被其它启用分组禁用时显示"被「××」禁用"徽标。
4. **Agent 工具**：`skill_toggles_list / disable / enable / enable_all / disable_all / source_set / group_create / group_delete / group_set_active`（均带可选 `group` 参数，缺省为默认分组）。
5. **改动生效时机**：

   | 路径 | 生效时机 |
   |---|---|
   | 输入框 `/` 技能菜单 | 下一次打开菜单（亚秒级） |
   | 模型 `<available_skills>` 目录 | 下一条消息（宿主"持久投影"机制，任何插件都如此） |
   | `skill` 工具 | 立即拒绝被禁用的技能 |

只管 skills，不做 MCP 开关。

## 已知限制

- Agent 未激活的冷会话由 preset 常驻 scope 供数，其 `/` 菜单可能仍显示已禁用技能，直到会话被激活（模型目录与 `skill` 工具不受影响）。
- 与旧插件 `dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager` **互斥**（两个影子 provider 叠加语义不可控），启动时检测到会打警告。
- 重装/升级**已安装** bundle 后，宿主半需要重启进程才换代码（Node 模块缓存）；浏览器半无此问题。

## 实现要点（维护者）

- 状态（v2）：`<DSH_HOME>/dsh-skill-toggles/state.json`，形如 `{ version:2, groups:[{id,name,disabled[]}], activeGroups[] }`；原子写；损坏回退为"全部启用"；v1 扁平文档加载时自动迁移进默认分组。
- 过滤机制：per-agent 影子 skill provider（`skill-toggles-filter`，注册在 agent 层）。`list()` 只发射"生效黑名单 ∧ 真实存在"的条目，invocation 改写为 `{modelInvocable:false, userInvocable:false}`，`rank:0` 在同层内直接胜出（文件系统根 rank 100..500）；启用的技能不重发，保留原 provider 的 `path` 预览与正文加载。
- 变更后 `control.invalidate()` 清空 skill registry 的 collect 缓存，再对每个活动会话 `emit('agent-preset/selected')` 使浏览器半目录缓存失效。
- 宿主半 `apply()` 保持同步（Cordis 对 prototype-bearing 函数的处理决定，异步 apply 会导致进程崩溃）。

## 开发

```
node test/state.test.mjs   # 纯逻辑 + 存储往返测试
```

```
dsh-skill-toggles/
├── lib/index.js        宿主半（影子 provider、RPC、9 个工具、事件广播）
├── lib/client.js       浏览器半（输入框按钮 + 分组管理悬浮面板）
├── lib/state.js        纯状态逻辑（分组黑名单语义 + v1 迁移，单测覆盖）
├── lib/store.js        原子写状态存储
├── scripts/cleanup.mjs postuninstall 清理
├── cordis.patch.yml    安装到 profile 的配置补丁片段
└── test/state.test.mjs
```

plugins.description: Deep-Sea Jellyfish theme for the Deepseek Harness Web UI: a bioluminescent abyss palette plus an illustration as the shell backdrop.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-jellyfish-theme

给 Deepseek Harness Web UI 用的**深海水母主题**插件：用一张水母插画作为整个界面的背景，并把配色改成生物荧光的深海色调（深海靛蓝底 + 青蓝强调色 + 藕紫辅助色）。浅色 / 深色两套调色板都做了适配。

> DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch`）+ 动态客户端插件。主机侧只有一行空实现，全部效果在浏览器侧完成。

![主题插画](assets/backdrop.jpg)

## 它做了什么

1. **重配色**：通过客户端 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('jellyfish', …)` 覆盖 40 多个 `--dsw-alias-*` 别名 token（背景、卡片、菜单、边框、文字、品牌色、气泡、代码块等），亮/暗两套值都给全，所以切换外观模式不会出现"半套配色"。
2. **铺插画**：注入样式表把插画作为 `html` 与 `body` 的固定背景（`cover`，纵向锚点在 32% 处，避免 `cover` 在宽窗口下裁到原图下方那条暗色桌面），并把宿主外框、对话面板的不透明底色让开，使画面能从侧栏与面板之间透出来。
3. **保可读**：在插画之上叠一层纵向渐变作为"可读性遮罩"（上下重、中间轻），中间阅读栏再叠一层高不透明度的霜层，卡片 / 菜单 / 弹层仍保持接近不透明——正文对比度按计算仍在 7:1 以上。

## 安装

### 方式 A：本地目录（推荐）

```bash
# profile 目录下
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-jellyfish-theme
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把它加进 bundle 列表：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "@local/jellyfish-theme"]
    }
  }
}
```

如果你用 DSH 的插件管理器，直接"从目录安装"指向本仓库目录即可（等价于上面的步骤）。

### 方式 B：git 依赖

```bash
pnpm add github:ailixiya24865-alt/dsh-jellyfish-theme
```

`client.js` 已经构建好并提交进仓库，因此不需要额外构建步骤。

### 安装 / 更新后必须做的一步 ⚠️

**改完代码或更新版本后，仅重新安装是不够的。** 如果 bundle 的选中状态没有变化，宿主会判定"无变化"（`changed:false`）而**不重新应用**，浏览器会继续运行旧的 `client.js`。必须让它真正重新应用：

1. 在插件页把本 bundle **关掉再打开**（或重启 Web 服务）；
2. 然后**硬刷新**页面（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

判断是否跑在新代码上：插件描述末尾带构建号，例如 `(v1.0.9)`。

## 重新构建

`client.js` 是由 `client.tpl.js` 生成的（把插画转成 base64 内联进 `background-image`）：

```bash
node tools/build-client.mjs
```

脚本会：把 `assets/backdrop.jpg` 内联进模板、写入构建号、把 `package.json` 版本号 +1、并把版本号同步进两个 locale 描述。**请编辑 `client.tpl.js`，不要直接改 `client.js`。**

## 目录结构

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | bundle 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client`、导出与 `files` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 向 loader 插入 `jellyfish-theme` 插件行 |
| `index.js` | 主机侧实现（当前为空，效果全在客户端） |
| `client.tpl.js` | **可编辑的客户端源码**（token 表、样式表、`apply`） |
| `client.js` | 构建产物，客户端加载器实际执行的文件 |
| `tools/build-client.mjs` | 构建脚本 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件页显示的标题与描述 |
| `assets/backdrop.jpg` | 背景插画（1680×885） |
| `icon.jpg` | 插件图标（由插画裁切） |
| `icon.svg` | 图标设计草稿（未在 `exports`/`files` 中，仅作素材保留） |

## 调参

想把画面调得更明显或更含蓄，改 `client.tpl.js` 里这几个变量（浅色与深色各一组），然后重新构建 + 重新应用：

| 变量 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `--jellyfish-veil` / `-soft` / `-strong` | 遮罩在画面中部 / 上方 42% / 顶部与底部的压暗强度 |
| `--jellyfish-surface-strong` / `-soft` | 中间阅读栏霜层在上下端 / 中段的浓度，越小插画越清晰、文字对比度越低 |
| `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` | 侧栏底色透明度（token 表里） |
| `--dsw-alias-bg-base` | 全局底色的透明度（token 表里） |

## 实现要点（改代码前值得读）

选择器不依赖 CSS Module 的哈希类名，而是锚在插槽属性上。运行时的真实结构是：

```
#root > div[data-slot="root"]            ← 插槽包装层，display: contents
  └ div.<frame>                          ← 外框（不是 #root 的第一个子元素！）
      ├ div.<sidebarCol>   > div[data-slot="sidebar"]
      ├ div.<centerCol>    > div[data-slot="main"]
      │                      > div[data-slot="main.conversation"] > div.<conversationRoot>
      ├ div.<rightbarCol>
      ├ div[data-shell-bottom]
      └ div[data-shell-overlay]
```

三条关键规则：

- 外框默认会以 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 铺满整个窗口（Windows 下还有更高优先级的 `[data-windows-titlebar] .frame`），必须显式清掉它的底色，插画才可能透出来；
- 中间列的霜层用 `div:where(:nth-child(2), :has(> [data-slot="main"]))` 双路匹配：`:where()` 是宽容语法，即使 `:has()` 不可用，位置分支仍然命中；
- 插画同时挂在 `html` 与 `body` 上：根元素的背景画在整个文档的画布层，任何后代都盖不住它；`body` 那份是防止某些样式表把根元素背景覆盖掉。

## 许可

- **代码**（`*.js`、`*.mjs`、`*.json`、`*.yml`、`*.md`）：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
- **插画**（`assets/backdrop.jpg`、`icon.jpg`，以及内联进 `client.js` 的那份 base64）：**不在 MIT 许可范围内**。它是本仓库作者提供的素材，仅随本插件一起分发；如果你不是权利人，请不要再次分发。想以纯代码方式使用本插件，可删除插画并把 `client.tpl.js` 中的背景层换成自己的素材。

---

## English summary

A Deep-Sea Jellyfish theme for the Deepseek Harness Web UI: bioluminescent abyss
palette (light and dark) plus an illustration as the shell backdrop, with a
gradient readability veil and a frosted reading column.

- Host half is empty; everything happens in `client.js` (client plugin).
- Edit `client.tpl.js`, then run `node tools/build-client.mjs`.
- **After installing or rebuilding, the bundle must be re-applied** (toggle it off
  and on in the plugin list, or restart the web service) and the page
  hard-refreshed; otherwise the browser keeps running the previous `client.js`.
- Code is MIT. The bundled illustration is **not** covered by the MIT license.

plugins.description: DSH 插件界面增强：卡片显示子项状态，设置页显示提供者包名，方便 AI 定位插件并节省 token。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-subitem-status

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**插件页**（侧栏「插件」，不是设置页）加上子项状态显示：
每张插件卡片上直接标出这个包里有哪些组件没启用、哪些异常，**不用点进详情页才发现**。

## 解决什么问题

插件页的卡片只反映 **bundle 级**的开关。包开着，但里面某个组件其实没跑起来——
卡片上完全看不出来，必须点进详情页看「包含的组件」那一行才发现。

这个插件把那行状态（`● 运行中` / `● 已关闭` / `● 未运行` / `● 异常`）**原样搬到卡片上**：

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ▣  some-plugin-kit                          │
│     一组示例插件                              │
│     主组件   ● 运行中   附属组件  ● 已关闭     │  ← 新增
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- 文案与状态点**直接取自官方字典命名空间**，与详情页一字不差；官方改措辞这里跟着变。
- 一个包里**多个组件就逐条列出**，不会只显示第一个。
- 每个组件显示一条状态（包括正常运行），没有组件时不占位。

## 设置页包名提示

设置中的配置页面导航及「插件」内部选项卡，标题下方显示淡色的提供者 npm 包名。
长包名省略显示，鼠标悬停可查看完整名字。

- 从 Slot 注册来源和实际加载的模块清单核对包名，不用中文标题推测。
- 6.0.1 中大量来源被压缩为 `mf`；对此使用已逐条核对注册源码的 ID→包名兜底表，
  且仍要求包名出现在当前模块清单中。表内覆盖 21 个设置页面、5 个内部选项卡。
  未收录的新页面显示「包名未声明」；其他插件覆盖同一 ID 时，此兜底信息可能不再准确。
- 来源未声明或无法确定时，显示「包名未声明」，不输出本机路径。
- 这是排障用的诊断信息，不是提供者身份的安全认证。
- 不读取配置值、聊天记录、账户凭据，不向外部服务发送数据。

### 把准确包名告诉 AI，减少 token 消耗

用途不只是方便查看：让 AI 修改或排查插件时，可以直接告诉它 **npm 包名**，
避免 AI 从中文显示名称开始逐个搜索、读源码猜来源，减少定位过程中的 token 消耗。

1. 打开设置，找到需要修改的插件配置选项卡，查看标题下面的包名小字。
2. 需要复制完整名称时，在浏览器中右键小字选择 **「检查」**，或按 **F12** 打开开发者工具，
   用元素选择器选中这行小字。在 Elements（元素）面板读取或复制该元素的文本；
   `title` 属性也包含完整包名，长名称不会因为界面省略显示而丢失。
3. 把完整包名与具体需求一起告诉 AI，例如：

   > 请检查 `dsh-feature-toggles`，设置里「余额」页面显示异常。先定位这个包，再排查问题。

不需要调试工具时，也可以直接看小字或悬停查看完整名称。若显示「包名未声明」，
不要把它当作真实包名提供给 AI；应进一步核实来源。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add github:lingmingxi/dsh-plugin-subitem-status --profile <你的 profile>
```

或用 tarball / 本地路径：

```bash
npm pack
dsh plugin add ./dsh-plugin-subitem-status-1.1.0.tgz --profile <你的 profile>
```

装完**重启 DSH**（客户端插件生效需要重启，除非 profile 启用了 client-hmr）。

## 设计要点

**纯客户端 DOM 增强，不覆盖 DSH 内核。**

插件页的卡片是内核 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` 里硬编码的 `PackageCard`，
**没有任何卡片级 slot 可用**（可用的只有 `plugins.item` 新增卡片、以及详情页的
`plugins.detail.badge/.actions/.section`）。所以「在父级卡片上显示子项状态」只能走
DOM 增强：观察已渲染的卡片，往里补一行。

- 数据源与官方插件页**同源**：`remote.pluginManager.listBundles()` + `listPlugins()`。
- 卡片定位只用稳定属性 `[data-plugin-package]` / `[data-plugin-panel]`；
  **类名是 CSS-module 哈希，绝不硬编码**。
- 被 React 重渲染抹掉时，由 `MutationObserver` 自动重放（自身写入的回调会跳过，避免死循环）。
- 卸载时清干净：样式、承载行、observer、订阅、定时器。

### 关于 `inject: []`（重要）

本插件的客户端 factory 声明 `inject: []`，所有服务一律用 `ctx.get()` 惰性读取。

这不是偷懒，是**必须的**。cordis 的 `ctx` 是注入代理：读一个没写进 `inject` 的属性会直接抛
`cannot get property "..." without inject`。而 DSH Web 的启动门禁要求**每个 entry 的 fiber 都 active**，
任何一个不合格就整页打不开（`web boot: N entry did not activate`）。

两种写法的实测结果：

| inject 声明 | 服务齐全 | 命名空间缺失 | remote 缺失 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `['remote','locale']` 且直接读 `ctx.remote.pluginManager` | **failed** | failed | failed |
| `['remote','locale','remote.pluginManager']` | active | **pending（照样卡死）** | pending |
| **`[]` + 全部走 `ctx.get()`** | **active** | **active** | **active** |

把命名空间写进 `inject` 看似正确，但该服务尚未挂载时 fiber 会变 `pending`，**同样卡死启动**。
只有 `ctx.get()` 在所有环境下都安全（官方插件页自己也用 `this.ctx.get("productAnalytics")?.`）。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

五个套件：

| 文件 | 覆盖内容 |
|---|---|
| `tests/smoke.mjs` | 纯逻辑：状态合成 vs 官方映射、多组件、文案兜底、注册形态 |
| `tests/dom.mjs` | DOM 粘合：单/多组件渲染、挂载位置、重渲染重放、实时更新、卸载清理 |
| `tests/boot-gate.mjs` | **启动门禁**：用真实 cordis 在 5 种服务组合下断言 fiber 必须 active |
| `tests/lifecycle.mjs` | 同步异常、迟到响应、卸载后的回调隔离 |
| `tests/settings.mjs` | 包名来源、未知/路径过滤、设置导航与内部 tab 对齐、重放与清理 |

`boot-gate.mjs` 需要 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`。可用 `DSH_CORDIS_PATH` 指向你自己的
`cordis/lib/index.js`（支持绝对路径和 `file:` URL）；找不到或加载失败则测试失败，避免假绿灯。
`tests/lifecycle.mjs` 另外验证同步异常及卸载后迟到响应不会继续运行。

> 为什么需要 boot-gate：这类 bug 用**普通对象桩测不出来**——桩里的 `ctx.remote` 是普通对象，
> 读 `.pluginManager` 不会报错，而真实 ctx 是注入代理。本插件第一版就是这么炸的，
> 所以补了这个用真实 cordis 的回归测试。

## 兼容性

- 平台：Web（`dsh.client.platform: "web"`）
- 无第三方运行时依赖，不 `require` 任何 Harness Client 包
- 只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，跟随明暗主题

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-message-reminder

A plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). When DSH asks you a question with `ask_user_question` while you are looking at something else, it raises a real acrylic notification card in the bottom-right corner of your Windows desktop. Clicking the card restores and raises the DSH window and navigates back to the Session that asked.

- Draws a borderless, always-on-top **acrylic** window (`SetWindowCompositionAttribute` + `DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE`, painted with `TextRenderer.DrawText`), because the renderer `Notification` API, `NotifyIcon` balloons and WinRT toasts all failed to show a banner in this Electron shell.
- **Never steals focus**, and the Session itself is untouched: the plugin only observes the `user-questions/request` waterfall (`{ prepend: true }`) and passes the answer back to the original listener.
- Stays quiet while the question card is already in front of you — the page reports "which Session is in the main view, is it visible, does it have focus" to the host.
- Host half uses Node built-ins only (`node:child_process`, `node:fs`, `node:path`) and registers a `webServer` route, so there are no runtime npm dependencies.
- Diagnostics: `GET /message-reminder/status`.

## Screenshot

![Notification card raised in the bottom-right corner of the Windows desktop](assets/screenshot-card.png)

A real card raised by `ask_user_question` while you are looking at something else: the title comes from the plugin config, the body is the question summary, and clicking anywhere on the card restores the DSH window and returns to the asking Session.

## Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with the Web client.
- Node.js >= 22.
- Windows 10 1803+ for the acrylic card. On macOS/Linux, or when PowerShell is unavailable, the host falls back to an in-page `Notification`.

## Install

Install it from the DSH plugin market (`dshmarket`) once the plugin is listed there, or add it to a profile by hand. Installing from a local checkout is the path that always works:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add link:/path/to/dsh-message-reminder
```

Once the package is published to npm, the registry form works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-message-reminder
```

The package declares its own bundle patch (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so it inserts its row into the profile when the profile loads. `dsh plugin add` is a `pnpm add` inside the profile, so make sure the package name also appears in that profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/<your-profile>/package.json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-message-reminder"] } }
}
```

## Configuration

Override by row id in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a `config` block replaces the whole default block, so repeat every field you want to keep):

```yaml
- id: message-reminder
  config:
    title: DSH 消息提醒                    # card title
    skipWhenViewingSession: true           # no card while the asking Session is on screen (default)
    skipWhenFocused: false                 # also skip the renderer notification while the page is focused
    windowProcessName: DeepSeek Harness    # process whose window is raised when the card is clicked
    sound: true                            # true | false | asterisk / exclamation / question / hand / beep
    notifyMode: auto                       # auto | balloon | renderer
```

`notifyMode: balloon` is the historical name of the helper-process card channel; `renderer` forces the page's own notification and is the easiest way to test without spawning a child process. The sound plays when the card is actually shown, so it never "beeps without a card".

## Files

```
index.js               host half: watches questions, spawns the card, serves the SSE channel
client.js              browser half: subscribes to the channel, navigates on click
notify.ps1             the card helper script (one short-lived process per question, ASCII-only)
cordis.patch.yml       inserts the host row into the current profile
locale/{zh,en}.json    the name and description shown for the plugin
icon.svg
```

## Known limitations

- The card only exists on Windows; every other platform uses the renderer notification.
- The blur needs `SetWindowCompositionAttribute` acrylic (Windows 10 1803+). If the system rejects the call the card degrades to a solid background and everything else still works.
- Some AMSI providers occasionally crash while PowerShell compiles the script; the host retries immediately (up to 5 times, ~0.1 s per failure) before falling back to the renderer notification.
- The card body is truncated at 160 characters; an over-long title is ellipsized.
- The first card is slightly slower than the rest (~1 s) because the helper compiles a small Win32 helper at startup.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

## 消息提醒 (Message Reminder)

DSH 调用 `ask_user_question` 询问用户时，在屏幕右下角弹出一张通知卡片；点击卡片会把 DSH 窗口恢复并置顶，同时自动回到发起询问的那个会话。

### 效果

![Windows 桌面右下角弹出的通知卡片](assets/screenshot-card.png)

标题取自插件配置（默认「DSH 消息提醒」），正文是问题摘要（超过 160 字符截断）；点击卡片任意位置即可回到发起询问的会话，点右上角 ✕ 只关掉卡片。

### 行为

| 时机 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 调用 `ask_user_question`，且页面**不在**该会话（或窗口已最小化） | 在工作区右下角（内缩 18px）弹出毛玻璃卡片并播放提示音，标题默认 `DSH 消息提醒`，正文为问题摘要（多个问题时附带「共 N 个问题」），底部提示「点击卡片返回对话」 |
| DSH 调用 `ask_user_question`，但页面正显示该会话**且窗口是当前活动窗口** | **不弹卡片、不响**：问题卡片已经在用户眼前的输入区里 |
| 点击卡片 | 把窗口恢复并置顶，然后把页面导航回发起询问的会话并展开待回答的问题卡片 |
| 点击右上角 ✕ | 忽略这条通知：卡片关闭，不置顶、不跳转；询问仍在原地等待回答 |
| 弹出 / 关闭 | 从屏幕右边缘**滑入**（约 260ms，ease-out-back，过冲约 20px 后回弹到位）；点击或 ✕ 后向左滑出关闭（约 150ms） |
| 问题被回答 / 被取消 | 卡片随辅助进程一起消失 |

会话本身与询问流程完全不受影响：插件只是观察 `user-questions/request`，并把决定继续交给原来的应答者。卡片不会抢焦点，鼠标悬停时描边变亮、✕ 出现底衬。

滑动只改窗口位置（15ms 一帧的 `Timer` 插值），**刻意不用透明度淡入**：淡入需要分层窗口，会和 DWM 合成的 acrylic 毛玻璃打架。实测轨迹（1920 屏幕）：

```
380ms left=1920  完全在屏幕右边缘外
400ms left=1822  滑入
480ms left=1459  过冲峰值（静止位 1482）
540ms left=1482  精确停在静止位并保持
```

「忽略」只是让辅助进程以退出码 `0` 结束（点击是 `42`），Host 会把这次结束归类为「已被忽略的气泡」，因此既不重试也不回退到渲染进程通知；下一次询问照常弹出。

#### 置顶是阶梯式的

Windows 的前台锁会让 `SetForegroundWindow` 无声失败，所以点击后按顺序尝试并**每步回验** `GetForegroundWindow`：

1. 若最小化则 `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)`，若被隐藏则 `SW_SHOW`，再 `BringWindowToTop`；
2. `AttachThreadInput` 挂到当前前台线程后 `SetForegroundWindow`（前台锁只会让给拥有前台窗口的线程），完成后解除挂接；
3. 仍被拒绝则轻敲一次 Alt 再试，然后换用 shell 自己的 `SwitchToThisWindow`；
4. 仍被拒绝且窗口本来不是置顶时，用一次「短暂 `HWND_TOPMOST` → `HWND_NOTOPMOST`」把 z 序顶上来（不会把用户从未固定的窗口留在置顶状态）；
5. 全都失败时 `FlashWindowEx` 闪任务栏按钮，至少让用户注意到。

实测三种情形都能把窗口带到最前：最小化、被另一个已聚焦窗口盖住、正常后台。

「是否已经在看这个会话」只有页面自己知道，所以 `client.js` 会把「当前 mainView 的会话 + 页面是否可见 + 页面是否聚焦」上报给 Host（`retainedBy.mainView`），Host 在询问到来时据此决定是否弹卡片。

判定「用户看不到」用的是两个信号的**与**：`visibilityState === 'visible'`（没被最小化/切到别的标签）**且** `document.hasFocus()`（是当前活动窗口）。Chromium 不提供遮挡信号——被别的程序完全盖住的窗口 `visibilityState` 仍然是 `visible`——所以聚焦状态是把「就在用户眼前」和「压在别的程序后面」区分开的那个信号。于是这几种情况都会提醒：

- 窗口被最小化；
- 窗口被其他程序盖住 / 用户切到别的程序；
- 窗口在另一个虚拟桌面；
- 看的是别的会话。

只有「窗口在前台、且正显示发起询问的会话」才不打扰。整条规则在 `isViewingAsk()` 里，配置项是 `skipWhenViewingSession`（设 `false` 则完全不抑制）。

### 结构

```
dsh-message-reminder/
├── index.js          Host 半边：监听询问、拉起卡片进程、提供 SSE 通道
├── client.js         浏览器半边：订阅通道、点击后导航
├── notify.ps1        卡片辅助脚本（每次询问一个短命进程，ASCII-only，每次按需读取）
├── cordis.patch.yml  把 Host 行插入当前 profile
├── locale/{zh,en}.json  插件卡片上显示的名称与说明
└── icon.svg
```

#### 为什么这样分工

- **Host 负责探测询问。** `user-questions/request` 是一条 waterfall；插件行在所有 bundle 行之后加载，若不声明 `prepend: true`，浏览器里回答问题的那个监听者会先返回结果，插件就永远看不到这次询问。因此 Host 以 `{ prepend: true }` 注册为最外层监听者，记录询问后用 `next()` 把回答权交回去。
- **Host 负责弹窗。** 渲染进程的 `Notification` API 需要与 AUMID 绑定的开始菜单快捷方式，这个 Electron 外壳没有。实测三种系统通知机制（渲染进程 `Notification`、`NotifyIcon` 气泡、WinRT toast）都被 Windows 送达通知中心却**从不显示横幅**，因此改为绘制一个置顶窗口：窗口不受该限制。卡片本身是**真毛玻璃**——`SetWindowCompositionAttribute(ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND)` 提供真实的背景模糊（须先设置 `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` 才会得到深色色调），`DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE` 负责圆角；文字用 `TextRenderer.DrawText` 直接画在窗口自己的 Paint 里，因为任何子控件都会用自己的背景盖掉模糊。
- **Client 负责导航。** Host 通过 `/message-reminder/events`（SSE，沿用 `dsh-client-hmr` 的通道写法）把 `ask` / `click` / `resolved` 推给页面，页面用 `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)` 回到会话。渲染进程无法自行恢复/置顶窗口，这一步由辅助脚本完成。

点击上报有两条独立通道：辅助脚本退出码 `42` 是 Host 信任的结论，stdout 的 `click` 只是抢先通知。找不到可用 PowerShell、或卡片连续 5 次没能启动时，Host 会改用 `channel: 'client'` 让页面自己发 `

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tui-marathon

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A Marathon-inspired appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness TUI. Version 0.4.3 provides an Acid Rain theme and a responsive full-screen opening through the stock TUI's public interfaces. Conversations, models, tools and storage remain with Harness / dsh-TUI.

**Inspired by the repo [ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop](https://github.com/ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop)**

![Startup animation captured from the installed dsh-tui](evidence/startup.gif)

Version 0.4.3: actual 120×36 terminal output, replayed as a 24 fps GIF (about 10.3 seconds). The logo stays visible through the blue hold and maze transition until the red sweep covers it. The native interface returns after the opening.

The repository is named `dsh-tui-marathon`; the installable Cordis package is `dsh-theme-mls-tui`.

## Install, then run dsh-tui

This assumes `dsh`, `dsh-tui` and pnpm are already installed and your existing `dsh-tui` starts successfully. Supported host: dsh-TUI 0.14.x; verified version: 0.14.0.

Install the theme once:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz
```

Keep using your usual command afterward:

```sh
dsh-tui
```

The plugin joins the launcher's default `dsh-tui` profile, selects Acid Rain and plays the opening automatically. No source checkout, host build or project-directory launch is needed. If you set `DSH_HOME`, use the same value during installation and startup. Restart `dsh-tui` after configuration changes or updates.

First-time host users can complete its normal credential setup after the opening. The theme does not change model, credential or session configuration.

Alternatively, download [the v0.4.3 archive](https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz) and replace the URL above with its local file path.

To remove the theme and keep using `dsh-tui`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-theme-mls-tui
```

## Appearance and compatibility

- Automatic animation runs only at startup. Successful turns, cancellations and history replay never open an animation.
- Acid Rain yellow `#D7FF00`, dark surfaces and neutral body text. The opening retains electric blue, maze graphics and the red panel exit.
- Actual terminal text, block glyphs, borders and solid color cells replace the old full-frame sampled renderer.
- Six green scan frames use heavy box-drawing strokes and closer spacing; the scan stage lasts 0.8 seconds longer than 0.4.2.
- Both whale axes share one physical scale. Borders, maze and panels fill the viewport independently, including host page margins.
- The host frame clock drives motion without the former 50ms quantization. Measured moving-frame output is approximately 58 fps; terminal and machine load affect results.
- Resizing works during playback and pause. Validation covers 48–180 columns, 20–54 rows and several physical cell proportions.

The stock pixel whale has hardcoded blue pixels. The plugin hides it through public `setWhale(false)`, keeps the themed native title and restores the previous preference on unload. Set `nativeWhale: true` to retain that sprite.

Stock `tuiScenes` replaces the conversation. Panel masks animate within the plugin scene; the original conversation returns on close. Progressive reveal of native content needs an additional host interface. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md).

## Controls and configuration

`Alt+M` replays the opening. During animation, `Esc`, `Enter`, `q` or click exits; space pauses/resumes. Configure Option as Alt/Meta on macOS when needed.

| Cordis option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoTheme` | `true` | Select and save MLS once on activation |
| `autoBoot` | `true` | Play the startup opening |
| `motion` | `full` | `reduced`: brief static display; `off`: theme only |
| `graphics` | `cells` | `auto`: use a supported host image only for the central logo; outer geometry stays native |
| `cellAspect` | `0` | Read host cell measurements; fall back to height / width = 2 |
| `nativeWhale` | `false` | Keep the unthemeable stock blue whale |

No terminal brand is required. If the host supplies no pixel metrics, arbitrary font proportions cannot be inferred exactly. Optional `cellAspect` calibration uses cell height / width, such as `1.8` or `2.2`. Native cell rendering needs no image protocol.

## Development

These steps are for source changes; theme installation does not require them. Source development uses Node `^22.19 || >=24` and pnpm `11.21.0`. Keep a stock `dsh-TUI/` checkout next to this repository for dev links and integration tests. The revision below is the verified host baseline:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.git
git -C dsh-TUI checkout 1d832df3f97e828b1aaea8376657d6b6ecf30b86
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI build
git clone https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon.git
cd dsh-tui-marathon
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
npm run build
npm test
npm run verify
```

For interactive development, `npm run setup:local` installs the official Harness CLI into ignored `.runtime/`; then run `npm start`. That launcher uses isolated development configuration and sessions. Normal use follows the `dsh-tui` workflow above. Configure API credentials through your shell environment as required by Harness. Do not commit credentials or sessions. Model-free tests need no API key.

Environment variables for the development launcher:

```sh
MLS_GRAPHICS=auto npm start
MLS_CELL_ASPECT=2.2 npm start
MLS_NATIVE_WHALE=1 npm start
MLS_MOTION=reduced npm start
npm start -- --inline
```

Optional development commands:

```sh
npm run measure:motion
npm run pack:local
```

MIT licensed; retain artwork attribution. See [QUALITY.md](QUALITY.md) for validation and [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md) for asset provenance and regeneration.

# dsh-vedar — Vedar (Kamchatka travel) MCP server for DeepSeek Harness

[中文](README.zh.md)

**Vedar** (vedarai.ru, Russian name Ведар) is the travel platform of the Kamchatka peninsula, Russia. Its public MCP server gives AI agents live tours and availability from local operators, the safety status of places and routes (volcanoes, earthquakes, weather warnings), weather, stays, gear rental, transfers and trip plans. No auth, rate-limited by IP.

This plugin does one thing: it registers one instance of the official bridge `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in your DeepSeek Harness profile, pointed at `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`. After install the model calls the tools as `mcp__vedar__<tool>`.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tourhabk-ui/dsh-vedar
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so pnpm must be on PATH (`npm i -g pnpm`); without it the command stops with "pnpm was not found".

Restart `dsh web`. The tools appear before the first turn.

No plugin? Put the same row into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (identical to `cordis.patch.yml` in this repository):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-vedar
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: vedar
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp
```

Or add it by URL in a settings panel (`dsh-mcp-center`, `dsh-mcp-panel`, `dsh-mcp-connector`): type Streamable HTTP, URL `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, auth none.

## Tools (20)

Read: `get_tours`, `get_tour_details`, `get_tour_availability`, `get_place_info`, `get_volcano_status`, `safety_status`, `get_guardian_context`, `get_weather`, `search_accommodations`, `search_gear`, `search_transfers`, `make_trip_plan`, `edit_trip_plan`, `get_request_status`, `search`, `fetch`.

Write, four requests confirmed by a human, no online payment: `create_lead`, `create_booking_request`, `create_stay_request`, `request_charter`.

Platform data is in Russian; tool arguments work best in Russian or English. Emergency number in Kamchatka: 112.

## Status

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and config fields may change. The row in this plugin follows the README of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 0.2.0-rc.2 (checked 2026-10-13). Verified end to end on 2026-10-14 with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and pnpm 10.28.0 (headless profile, GitHub Actions runner): the plugin installed with the command above, and DeepSeek answered a Chinese question about brown bears in August by calling 17 Vedar tools, all completed. Please report problems at [tourhabk-ui/pos](https://github.com/tourhabk-ui/pos/issues).

Русский: плагин DeepSeek Harness, который одной командой подключает MCP-сервер Ведара. Исходник живёт в `integrations/dsh-vedar/` репозитория платформы.

More: [vedarai.ru/mcp](https://vedarai.ru/mcp) · [vedarai.ru/zh](https://vedarai.ru/zh) · [llms.txt](https://vedarai.ru/llms.txt) · manifest [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/mcp.json)

MIT

plugins.description: 本地环境管理
plugins.readme_text:
# ployenv

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A portable, single-binary version manager for local language runtimes —
**Node.js, Java, Go and Python** — with nothing to install and nothing to
configure.

No installer, no account, no licence checks, and **no changes to your system
environment**. Drop one executable anywhere; its runtimes and settings live next
to it.

```console
$ ployenv install node@20
$ ployenv use node@20
$ ployenv shell
```

## Why ployenv

- **Non-invasive** — never edits the system `PATH`, `.npmrc`, `pip.ini` or the
  registry. Activating a version affects one terminal window only.
- **Explicit** — official sources by default. ployenv adopts an existing
  installation only when you ask it to, and never guesses.
- **Predictable** — the effective version comes from a project file (`.ployenv`,
  plus `.nvmrc`, `.tool-versions` and friends) or from one global default, and
  `PLOYENV_<LANG>_VERSION` overrides both. Nothing ever falls back to "some
  installed version".
- **Portable** — a single ~7.5 MB static binary with zero third-party
  dependencies. Move the folder, keep everything.
- **Scriptable** — `--json` output is pure ASCII (non-ASCII characters are
  escaped as `\uXXXX`), so it survives any console code page.

## Install

Windows 10/11 is the primary target; Linux and macOS (amd64/arm64) are built and
validated on native runners by CI. The macOS binaries are unsigned and unnotarized,
so the first run may need `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine`. Building needs **Go 1.22+**.

```powershell
go build -ldflags "-s -w" -o dist/ployenv.exe ./cmd/ployenv
```

Or, if script execution is allowed:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\build.ps1 -Test
```

Then put the binary on your `PATH`, for example `D:\PloyEnv\ployenv.exe`.

## Quick start

```powershell
# see what is available
ployenv available node --limit 5

# install a runtime (22, lts and latest all work)
ployenv install node@20
ployenv install java@21
ployenv install go@1.24
ployenv install python@3.12

# record a default, then inspect
ployenv use node@20
ployenv current
ployenv list

# activate it in this terminal only
ployenv shell
```

Pin a project by adding a `.ployenv` file next to its source:

```ini
node=20.20.2
java=21
go=1.24
python=3.12
```

`ployenv use node@20 --project` writes or updates this file for you.

## Documentation

The full command reference, configuration and troubleshooting guide lives in
**[docs/manual.md](docs/manual.md)** ([简体中文](docs/manual.zh-CN.md)).

Highlights:

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `ployenv support` | List supported runtimes |
| `ployenv available <lang>` | Installable versions |
| `ployenv doctor` | Paths, writability and resolution report |
| `ployenv config` | Show or change every setting |

Run `ployenv --help` for the built-in summary.

## Roadmap

**Done**

- [x] Portable data directory, one-time base configuration
- [x] Node.js, Java, Go and Python, each described by a built-in Spec
- [x] Mirror fallback, and interrupt-safe cleanup (`Ctrl+C` leaves no partial files)
- [x] SHA-256 verification for Go archives (node / Java / Python checksums still to come)
- [x] Session activation without touching the system environment
- [x] `--json` machine interface
- [x] Prebuilt archives published to GitHub Releases (windows / linux / darwin on
      amd64 / arm64, with checksums)

**Next**

- [ ] Configurable runtime definitions (FR-11). Today runtime definitions are
      compiled-in Go code; `config.json` cannot add or override one yet
- [ ] Checksums for node, Java and Python, and a `doctor` connectivity check
      against every configured download source
- [ ] Remaining runtimes on the same `Spec` definition, including the database
      and middleware kinds (`MySQL`, `Redis`, `Nginx`) that already have a
      reserved `kind` field
- [ ] shell completion scripts; `--dry-run` is rejected until it is implemented (it used to be accepted and silently ignored, BUG-020)
- [ ] Log rotation honoring `logs.keep`

**Not planned**

- Automatic switching on `cd` — it needs a global shell hook, which would break
  the non-invasive promise. Use `ployenv shell` in each project terminal.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © MOMIEDEJIYI

# dsh-client-ui-skin-bayern

[![awesome · DSH plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

拜仁慕尼黑（FC Bayern München）主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤 —— 主场红 / 客场白双配色，
真实赛场球员照片背景，外加四种程序绘制的插画背景。全部通过 dsh 的 `--dsw-*` 设计 token
重映射，与 `@pakiknowledge/dsh-client-ui-skin-claude` 同构（一个 `dsh.client.platform = web`
的浏览器端 bundle）。

![暗色 · 主场红](preview/dark.png)
![亮色 · 客场白](preview/light.png)

## 特性

- **球衣配色（主场红 ⇄ 客场白）**：一键切换整个画布
  - 主场红：深红黑画布（跟随系统明暗，亮色时是暖红纸面）
  - 客场白：纸白画布，不随系统明暗变化
- **背景主题** 五档：`photo` 真实赛场照片 / `jersey` 球员球衣 / `squad` 阵容号码墙 /
  `stadium` 安联球场 / `plain` 纯色
- **19 名一线队球员**：诺伊尔 1、乌帕梅卡诺 2、金玟哉 3、塔 4、基米希 6、格纳布里 7、
  格雷茨卡 8、凯恩 9、萨内 10、科曼 11、迪亚斯 14、奥利塞 17、戴维斯 19、布朗 21、
  穆勒 25、莱默 27、赛巴里 34、穆夏拉 42、帕夫洛维奇 45
- **4 种强调色**：拜仁红 #DC052D / 深红 #8B0F22 / 拜仁蓝 #0066B2 / 冠军金 #C9A227
- **自定义背景图**：设置行里粘图片 URL 即可替换
- 亮 / 暗双主题跟随系统；侧栏毛玻璃、俱乐部色顶部细线、俱乐部色滚动条与选中色
- 照片缺失时优雅回退：某个球员没有照片，`photo` 主题会自动改用该球员的球衣插画

![插画背景](docs/backdrop-squad.png)
![安联球场](docs/backdrop-stadium.png)

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dirtywork22/dsh-client-ui-skin-bayern

# 或发布到 npm 之后
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-client-ui-skin-bayern
```

`dsh plugin add` 会自动把这个包登记进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
**不需要手改任何配置文件**；刷新页面即可看到皮肤。

想关掉皮肤时把它从 `bundles` 里去掉，或给对应的加载项加 `disabled: true`。

皮肤互斥：同一时刻只启用一个皮肤，启用本皮肤时给其它皮肤行加 `disabled: true`。

## 照片不随包分发

这个仓库**不含**任何球员照片：赛场照的版权属于原媒体 / 摄影师。安装后你是
「四种程序绘制的插画背景 + 空照片表」，两种方式补上照片：

```sh
# 1) 一键抓取（从公开图片索引，排除图库 / 水印源，抓完自动嵌入并重新嵌入 bundle）
node tools/fetch-photos.mjs

# 2) 或者用你自己的图：把图片放进 photos/<球衣号码>.jpg
node tools/embed-photos.mjs
```

`embed-photos.mjs` 会把 `photos/` 里的图片以 data URI 内联进 `lib/client.js`，
所以刷新页面即生效，不需要重新安装。照片仅供本地个人使用，请自行确认素材授权。

想用竖构图 / 海报当背景时，`tools/from-image.mjs` 可以完整保留原图内容
（两侧用图自身的模糊延伸填满 16:9）：

```sh
node tools/from-image.mjs photos/_user/my-poster.jpg 42 --frame blur --keep-source
```

## 设置（设置 → 通用）

1. **球衣配色** — 主场红 / 客场白
2. **背景主题** — 真实赛场照片 / 球员球衣 / 阵容号码墙 / 安联球场 / 纯色
3. **背景球员** — 19 名一线队球员
4. **强调色** — 拜仁红 / 深红 / 拜仁蓝 / 冠军金
5. **自定义背景图** — 粘 URL 应用，留空恢复

选择即时生效并保存在浏览器 localStorage。

> 这 5 行由**一次** slot 注册渲染，且只用原生 React 元素（`<select>` / `<input>`）。
> 设置面板会静默丢弃渲染时报错的行，改动设置行后跑一次 `node tools/verify-settings.mjs`
> 就能在真 React 渲染里发现问题。

## 工具

| 用途 | 命令 |
|---|---|
| 抓取球员照片 | `node tools/fetch-photos.mjs`（`--only 9 42` 指定号码，`FORCE=1` 覆盖） |
| 嵌入照片 | `node tools/embed-photos.mjs` |
| 生成预览图 | `node tools/preview.mjs`（`--art` 出插画版） |
| 设置面板自检 | `node tools/verify-settings.mjs` |
| 人脸留白自检 | `python tools/facecheck.py 0.12`（OpenCV 检出脸部并量化头顶空间） |
| 补顶部保护带 | `python tools/headroom.py 0.15 [号码...]`（头顶太贴边时自动下压） |
| 裁剪参考线 | `node tools/safearea.mjs 0.12`（标出页面会裁掉的区域，目视复核） |
| 重裁全部照片 | `node tools/reframe.mjs` |
| 用自己的图 | `node tools/from-image.mjs <图片> <号码> --frame blur\|plain\|cover` |
| 发布到 GitHub | `pwsh -File tools/publish-github.ps1 -Token <PAT> -Owner <用户>` |

隔离冒烟测试（另起实例在 3099 端口验证插件在真实启动流程里不报错）：

```sh
dsh web --patch tools/smoke-overlay.yml --port 3099 --no-open
```

## 许可

MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。插画背景全部是代码绘制的几何图形与文字，队徽为占位图形，
不含任何俱乐部官方素材；球员姓名与号码仅用于个人非商业的主题化描述，相关商标归其权利人所有。

# dsh-usage-dock

![dsh-usage-dock 效果图](docs/screenshot.png)

DSH Web 插件：在输入框下方的状态条里，与内置"缓存命中"统计同行显示智谱 GLM Coding Plan 套餐额度（5 小时 / 每周窗口）与 DeepSeek 账户余额，按当前选中模型自动切换。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/baozhadepiqiu/dsh-usage-dock.git
systemctl --user restart dsh-web
```

密钥走 DSH 凭据体系（设置 → API 密钥，或环境变量），本插件不落盘任何密钥。

## 开发

TypeScript（strict）。源码在 `src/`（server.ts / client.tsx / types.ts），`lib/` 与 `dist/` 为构建产物。

```bash
npm install --cache .npm-cache
npm run typecheck    # tsc --noEmit
npm run build        # src -> lib/index.js + lib/client.js + dist/*
npm run smoke        # 离线冒烟测试
```

改服务端或客户端后 `npm run build`，再 `systemctl --user restart dsh-web` 生效。详见 `agent.md`。
