--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Standalone WorkBuddy account and model provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH WorkBuddy

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Independent WorkBuddy account plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Adds Settings → WorkBuddy for browser sign-in, account status, credit balances and package expiry, and a searchable model catalog with free-model filtering, credit multipliers, promotions, and capabilities. The model selector exposes the account's chat models under the WorkBuddy provider, distinguishes duplicate names by ID, and labels explicitly free models. This package is independent of the A2D2 orchestration and DimAgent plugins.

The host plugin delegates model requests to DSH's existing `PiAiAdapter`. The separately supervised Python service imports the maintained [workbuddy2api](https://github.com/Zhengyuuuui/workbuddy2api) implementation for streaming and tool-call protocol conversion. Tokens stay on the service host; the browser receives only an authorization link and account status. No WorkBuddy desktop process is required after browser authorization.

## Screenshots

Captured from the plugin's Chinese interface. Account identity, balances, and package expiry dates are redacted. Model availability, multipliers, and promotions reflect the capture date and may change.

### Account and Credits

![WorkBuddy settings with account status and redacted credit packages](docs/screenshots/settings-overview.png)

### Model Search

Duplicate display names retain their distinct model IDs and billing information.

![DeepSeek search results showing distinct model IDs and billing](docs/screenshots/deepseek-models.png)

### Free Models

Free labels come from explicit upstream billing data and active promotions.

![Free-only filter showing three models](docs/screenshots/free-models.png)

## Install

Build with `pnpm install && pnpm build`, then install the bundle using `dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy`. Configure the entry in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: workbuddy
  config:
    gatewayBaseURL: https://workbuddy-gateway.example.com
    gatewayKeyFile: /absolute/path/to/workbuddy-gateway-key
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    catalogTtlMs: 60000
    streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300000
```

The key file contains the gateway's bearer credential, with no environment-variable assignment. Do not place upstream tokens in DSH configuration or source control. The gateway endpoint must be protected by authentication; the Python listener should remain on loopback behind that gateway.

## Service

Validated upstream revision: `1cc32c9a98abb53796d8d4e8d477736fe1f0c4cc`. Install its dependencies with `uv sync` and run its virtual environment's `uvicorn --app-dir /absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy/server workbuddy_service:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18788`. Set the following environment variables through the service supervisor:

| Variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `WORKBUDDY_PROXY_SOURCE` | Checkout of the pinned upstream repository |
| `WORKBUDDY_ENDPOINT` | WorkBuddy backend origin, normally `https://www.workbuddy.ai` |
| `WORKBUDDY_SESSION_FILE` | Private, writable credential file; existing proxy sessions are accepted |
| `WORKBUDDY_LOGIN_TTL_SECONDS` | Authorization expiry in seconds, normally `300` |
| `WORKBUDDY_LOG_FILE` | Protocol summary log path |

Use Supervisor or another persistent service manager, with a single service worker to own the account and its pending login. Refresh is serialized, and credential updates use atomic file replacement. Sign-out removes this service's authorization without revoking other devices. An expired login can be restarted from Settings. The gateway access key is deployment authentication, distinct from WorkBuddy account authorization.

## Verify

Run `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm build`. For service tests use the upstream virtual environment with `PYTHONPATH=/path/to/upstream/server:/path/to/dsh-workbuddy/server pytest server/test_session.py server/test_pricing.py`. Real acceptance additionally requires DSH settings rendering, an authorized account, streamed text, and a tool-call round trip. Upstream currently has one stale client-header assertion; this package does not alter or suppress it.

## Remove

Remove this bundle through the DSH plugin manager and stop its dedicated services. Existing DSH providers and sessions are unaffected. WorkBuddy credentials are retained on disk unless signed out before removal.

## License

Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). The separately installed upstream project retains its own license.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DSH Desktop 自制插件：综合平台（用量统计 / 归档 / 记忆 / FreeModel 四页）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

DSH Harness 的自制插件。两个：

| 插件 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-comprehensive-platform` | 把自制功能收进设置里的一个页面，导航名「综合平台」 |
| `dsh-localcoding-mcp` | 把 LocalCodingMCP 接进宿主：本地工具入表、任务出给 Codex、隧道打通网页版 ChatGPT |

## 综合平台（`dsh-comprehensive-platform`）

### 页面

综合平台是一个设置页、4 个页签：用量统计 / 归档历史 / 记忆系统 / FreeModel。

前三页（用量统计 / 归档历史 / 记忆系统）用本插件自己的 `/dsh-desktop/*` 路由，数据在本插件里。

第四页 FreeModel **不是本插件写的页面**：它是 `dsh-our-free-model` 的设置页。做法是把它自己的
代码取过来，只改必须改的地方（清单在 `tools/vendor-our-free-model.mjs` 的文件头与服务端阶段的
注释里，每处都写了为什么），再挂成这一页的第四个页签：

- **页面**（前端）内嵌在 `client.js` 的 VENDOR 段里，十三处改动，含删掉它的「免费模型」页、
  去掉它自己的标题行与「公告中心」面板、EAC 挪到第三、API 指向本插件自己的前缀。
- **服务端**在 `free-model/`，提供 `/api/comprehensive-platform/free-model/*`。
  它自己的自更新、公告通道与热重载都已停用——那三样都会改写已安装的字节，而那些字节现在是
  本插件的；数据目录也换成自己的，避免两个插件写同一份目录。

所以这一页**不依赖任何其他插件**：装这一个就完整可用。那 8 个页面（白嫖模型接入 / 聚合渠道 /
EAC 模型 / 省 Token / 路由 / 数据看板 / 运行日志 / 网关设置）的行为与原版一致。
来源与改动写在 `free-model/NOTICE.md`。

> **那 13 个账号渠道的包不在这个仓库里。** `free-model/vendor/channel-pack/` 是第三方项目的整份拷贝，
> 里面带着它的 Google OAuth 凭据；本仓库是公开的，推上去等于公开别人的凭据（GitHub 的推送保护也确实拦了）。
> 所以它 `.gitignore` 掉了，只留在装了它的机器上。缺了它插件照常工作：渠道列表会显示「渠道包不可用」
> 与原因，其余页面（免费车道、EAC 模型、账本、日志、网关、省 Token、路由）不受影响——这是它自己的降级路径。
> 它的 LICENSE 与 NOTICE 仍然在仓库里，第三方来源有据可查。
## 本地编码 MCP（`dsh-localcoding-mcp`）

**不启动任何外部程序。** 工具直接实现在本插件里（Node + 宿主 `ctx.tools.register`），
没有子进程、没有本地端口、没有需要单独编译的二进制。四个方向：

- **本地工具**：宿主工具表多出 30 多个 `lcm_*` 工具 —— 读写改文件、目录操作、搜索与符号定位、
  git 状态/差异/提交/还原、构建与测试、长驻进程会话、以及一个**可撤销的改动日志**
  （`lcm_undo_last_change`）。所有路径都被限制在工作区内，越界直接拒绝。
- **对外提供 MCP**：插件自己在 `/mcp` 上提供 MCP（streamable HTTP），
  和本地工具是**同一批实现**。Codex 用 `codex mcp add dsh-localcoding --url http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp` 接进来。
- **本应用模型给 Codex 用**：插件在 `/v1` 上提供 OpenAI 兼容端点，背后是宿主的 `llm` 服务。
  设置页一个按钮把 `~/.codex/config.toml` 改成指向它（**改前自动备份**，可一键还原），
  于是 Codex 跑的就是本应用正在用的模型 —— 不需要第三方中转、不需要单独的 API Key、不用 `codex login`。
- **网页版 ChatGPT → 本地**：`chatgpt.com` 的连接器够不到 `127.0.0.1`，
  所以设置页按账号起 `tunnel-client.exe`（OpenAI 官方**出站**守护进程），
  它主动连 OpenAI 控制面；之后在 `chatgpt.com/#settings/Connectors` 里选中这条隧道，
  网页版 ChatGPT 就能调用上面那批工具。**这是唯一不需要开放入站端口的接法。**
  设置页可按账号启停、看 `/readyz` 与 `doctor` 输出，并提示
  `/readyz` 只证明进程活着 —— 真正的验收是去连接器里发一次真实工具调用。
  可选的浏览器面（Playwright MCP）也走同一个连接器。

设置页显示：工具表、两个端点的地址与可直接粘贴的客户端配置、Codex 状态、隧道舰队。
`sourceMode: 'external-mcp'` 是给「别人已经在跑 LocalCodingMCP.exe」的场景留的**只连接、不启动**模式。

> 两个账号相关的前提本机还不满足：`accounts.json` 里三个账号的 `organizationId` 都是空的
> （会得到 `403 tunnel_active_organization_required`），隧道 ID 也可能已过期需要在
> `platform.openai.com/settings/organization/tunnels` 重新建。控制面密钥是 DPAPI 加密串，
> 只在内存里解开，不进日志、不进响应、不进任何配置。

## 安装

前置：**DSH Desktop 至少启动过一次**（profile 的 `package.json` 由它生成），PATH 上有 `pnpm`
（`corepack enable pnpm` 或 `npm i -g pnpm`）。不需要装别的插件：四个页签的数据都在本插件里。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/TiaYahng/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-to-profile.ps1 -Plugin dsh-comprehensive-platform
```

重启 DSH Desktop，插件管理里出现「综合平台」即可。脚本做四件事：把插件复制进
`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\plugins`、在 profile 的 `package.json` 里注册
`file:` 依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`、删掉 `node_modules` 里的旧拷贝再 `pnpm install --force`
（pnpm 对 `file:` 依赖是实体拷贝而不是链接，不删就还在跑旧代码）、最后确认
`cordis.patch.yml` 进了 `node_modules`。

只想要「综合平台」就带 `-Plugin dsh-comprehensive-platform`。不带这个参数会装上仓库里的两个插件，
而 `dsh-localcoding-mcp` 需要本机有编译好的 `LocalCodingMCP.exe`（仓库里没有），缺它跑起来是坏的。
其他参数：`-DshHome` / `-Profile` 换目标，`-SkipPnpm` 只复制与注册、不装依赖。

装完用这两条路由自检（宿主在跑时返回 200 即已激活）：

```
/dsh-desktop/usage-stats/summary   综合平台 › 用量统计
/dsh-desktop/shell/archive.list    综合平台 › 归档历史
```

**换一套 harness 数据目录时不要用这个脚本**，它第 3 步的 pnpm 在那套 profile 上会把
`node_modules` 弄坏（原因见 `docs/ENGINEERING.md`）。手动三步：

```powershell
# $P 指向目标 profile 目录（harness home 下的 profiles\<profile>）
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force "$P\plugins\<插件名>" "$P\node_modules\<插件名>"
```

`package.json` 里要有 `dependencies` 的 `file:` 条目与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 的行，
然后在插件管理里把该 bundle 关一次再开一次，即刻生效、不用重启。
**改完服务端代码仍需重启应用**（Node 的 ESM 模块缓存不随开关插件清除）。

## 给 agent 与自动化安装

宿主自带的插件通道接受四种源：**npm 包名 / Git 仓库地址 / 归档链接 / 本机目录**
（设置 › 插件 › 插件管理里的安装对话框，或 `dsh plugin add <源>`）。按这四种源看：

| 源 | 现在能用吗 | 还需要什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 本机目录 | ✅ 已验证 | 克隆仓库后跑 `install-to-profile.ps1`（见上）。脚本做的事与宿主通道一致，只是替你写 profile 的 `package.json` |
| Git 仓库地址 | ⚠️ 未验证 | 本仓库是**多插件仓库**，宿主按包名安装单个插件，需要指向子目录的写法；本仓库尚未按这个形态验证过 |
| 归档链接 | ⚠️ 未验证 | 同上 |
| npm 包名 | ❌ 还没有 | 插件尚未发布到 npm，且 `package.json` 里 `private: true`、没有 `files` 字段 |

所以今天给别的 agent 的答案是**本机目录**那一条：克隆 → 跑脚本 → 重启应用 → 打路由自检。
要让「一条命令装上」成立，需要先把每个插件单独发布到 npm，并把 `private`、`files`、
`engines.dsh`、`dsh-plugin` 关键字补齐。

更新同一条路：`git pull` → 重跑脚本 → **重启应用**。

上架插件列表（收录后市场就能搜到）的投稿文件与步骤在 `docs/market-entry.yml`：
目录不是市场本地索引，而是由 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 仓库生成，收录要往那边提一个 PR。

## 更新

```powershell
cd dsh-plugins
git pull
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-to-profile.ps1 -Plugin dsh-comprehensive-platform
```

然后**重启 DSH Desktop**。前端（`client.js`）改动本可以靠插件管理里关一次开一次热加载，
但服务端是 Node 的 ESM，模块缓存不随开关清除——不重启就还在跑旧的服务端代码，
而前端已经变了，两边对不上。

内嵌的那份副本要跟上上游时：先升级 profile 里的 `dsh-our-free-model`，再跑

```powershell
node tools\vendor-our-free-model.mjs
```

重新生成副本（十二处改动都记在 `tools/vendor-our-free-model.mjs` 里），然后跑自检、再重装本插件。

## 环境

- 宿主 harness `0.2.0-rc.2`，peer 依赖都是宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/*`
- 内嵌的上游版本：`dsh-our-free-model` 2.1.0（前端与服务端都在本仓库里，见 `free-model/NOTICE.md`）
- `dsh-localcoding-mcp` 需要已编译的 `LocalCodingMCP.exe`（0.3.0）；网页版方向另需
  `mcp-accounts\tunnel-client.exe` 与 `config\accounts.json`（可选 Playwright MCP 另需扩展令牌）
- Codex CLI 走的是第三方中转，`codex login status` 说「未登录」是**预期**的（中转用 bearer
  token，不用 OpenAI 账号登录）；真正的就绪判据是插件去探中转入口能不能连通

## 自检

```powershell
node .\test\platform-client.test.mjs .\plugins\dsh-comprehensive-platform\client.js
node .\test\archive-delete.test.mjs
node .\test\free-model-standalone.test.mjs
node .\test\schema-calls.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-client.test.mjs .\dsh-localcoding-mcp\client.js
node .\test\localcoding-native.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-process.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-tunnel.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-plugin.test.mjs
node .\test\localcoding-server.test.mjs
```

前两个前端自检必须带 `client.js` 的路径参数（只认位置参数，不吃环境变量）。
`localcoding-plugin.test.mjs` **默认加载 profile 里那份将要被宿主加载的副本**，
跑完整的 `apply()`，所以漏部署一个文件会在这里报错而不是在应用里。
`localcoding-server.test.mjs` 需要本地 MCP 服务器在跑。

不需要装依赖。实现细节、踩过的坑与未验证项见 [docs/ENGINEERING.md](docs/ENGINEERING.md)。

plugins.description: Render AI answers as interactive UI cards in DSH: comparisons, charts, diagrams, tables, calculators and unit conversions. The model writes a JSON spec — never markup.
plugins.readme_text: **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # dsh-smart-ui Structured UI cards for DSH conversations. The model calls one tool, `ui_render`, writes a JSON spec — and the page renders an interactive card: comparisons, charts, headline figures, ordered steps, tables, live calculators, unit conversions, flowcharts. Answers are often structures: three or more things compared on shared criteria, a series of magnitudes, a handful of headline numbers, ordered steps, rows of records, arithmetic the user wants to redo with their own numbers. In plain text those cost tokens and read badly. This plugin hands the structure to a card and leaves the prose as the conclusion. - **The model writes data, never HTML/JSX.** The spec is plain JSON; it goes into the session log and redraws identically after a fork or a resume. - **The card is a pure function of the tool arguments.** Nothing is fetched from the host, so a reload or a resumed session gets the same card. - **Light and dark both work.** A spec only carries semantic tones (`success`, `warn`, …); the client resolves them to theme tokens, so the model never writes a literal color. ## Card types | `kind` | When to use | Main fields | |--------|-------------|-------------| | `compare` | three or more things compared on shared criteria | `columns`, `rows[{label, cells[]}]` | | `chart` | a series of magnitudes (`bar`), a trend (`line`), parts of one whole (`pie` / `donut`) | `series[{label, value, tone?, hint?}]`, `variant`, `unit` | | `stats` | two to six headline figures | `stats[{label, value, tone?, hint?}]` | | `progress` | one ratio to feel at a glance — pass rate, quota used | `value`, `max`, `label`, `unit`, `tone` | | `steps` | three or more ordered steps | `steps["text" \| {text, detail?}]` | | `table` | rows and columns of records | `columns`, `rows[][]` | | `diagram` | boxes joined by arrows: flow, decision tree, hierarchy, dependency or class sketch | `nodes[{id, label, detail?, tone?}]` + `edges[{from, to, label?}]` + `layout`, or raw `mermaid` | | `calculator` | arithmetic the user will redo with their own numbers — bill split, tip | `mode: split \| tip`, `fields[{label, value, min?, max?}]` | | `unit` | a quantity converted between units | `units`, `factors?`, `from`, `to`, `value` | | `note` | one thing the reader must not miss | `text`, `tone` | Every card also takes `title` (heading) and `caption` (footnote). `diagram` has two forms: a structured `nodes` + `edges` list (compiled to a Mermaid flowchart; `layout: "tree"` draws a top-down hierarchy) or complete `mermaid` source (sequence, state machine, Gantt, ER, and the rest of the diagram family). Exactly one of the two. ## How it works ```text the model writes a spec (plain JSON) ↓ index.js registers the ui_render tool and one prompt section: validation, normalization, oversize errors back to the model ↓ client.js renders the card in the tool.call.toolview slot ``` - `index.js` is the host half: the tool schema, `normalizeSpec` and the Mermaid compilation all live here, so the session log stores exactly the diagram that was drawn. - `client.js` is the client half: `compare` / `stats` / `steps` / `table` / `note` / `calculator` / `unit` are plain React, `progress` is inline SVG, `chart` goes through ECharts, `diagram` through Mermaid. - The chart libraries are **lazy chunks**: `client.echarts.js` / `client.mermaid.js` are generated, loaded on first use, and never committed. ## Install Add this repo to your DSH profile dependencies — a local `link:` or a GitHub URL both work: ```json { "dependencies": { "dsh-smart-ui": "link:" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-smart-ui"] } } } ``` Insert the plugin line in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: smart-ui name: 'dsh-smart-ui' ``` Then install: ```bash cd "$DSH_PROFILE_DIR" pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile ``` ## Build The two chart chunks are **generated** and git-ignored. Build them after installing, or charts fall back to a plain-text summary: ```bash pnpm install node build-echarts.mjs # writes client.echarts.js node build-mermaid.mjs # writes client.mermaid.js ``` The scripts wrap the npm dist files in DSH's module-loader envelope: ECharts takes its UMD `exports` branch (no global leak), and Mermaid's API is captured off `globalThis` before the global is deleted again. ## Tests ```bash node test/normalize.mjs # spec normalizer self-check: happy path + guards, per kind node test/echarts-chunk.mjs # loads the generated chunk without a browser, asserts a usable ECharts node test/render-svg.mjs # ECharts SSR renders charts and flowcharts into test/out for inspection node test/render-mermaid.mjs # renders the Mermaid diagram families headless into test/out-mermaid node test/shot-mermaid.mjs # Chrome screenshots (Mermaid labels are foreignObject HTML) ``` The last two look for Chrome / Edge (default Windows install paths). ## Deliberate limits | Limit | Value | Why | |-------|-------|-----| | nodes per spec | 400 (`apply(ctx, { maxNodes })`) | a runaway model cannot wedge the page | | raw `mermaid` source | 12000 chars | one card cannot swallow the page | | `diagram` forms | exactly one | the two paths can never disagree | ## Acknowledgments Thanks to everyone who contributed to this project: [](https://github.com/windzxy) [](https://github.com/anyiba) ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). This repo contains no chart-library code (the generated chunks are git-ignored); the build pulls them from npm: ECharts under Apache License 2.0, Mermaid under MIT.

plugins.description: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
plugins.readme_text:
中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.3**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。已在最新版 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 实测：三形态接入（原生一等工具 / web_search seam / wide_research）均可正常启用。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用引擎 | | **Chrome** | ❌ 可选 | 页面截图、JS 渲染页、登录态抓取 | 截图工具不可用，其余正常 | | **pdfplumber / PyMuPDF** | ❌ 可选 | PDF 提取 | argo_pdf 不可用，其余正常 | | **Playwright** | ❌ 可选 | 截图增强 | 截图工具回退 Chrome CDP，其余正常 | 安装脚本（install.sh）只自动装前两个；其余可选依赖按需 `pip install` 或 `brew install` 即可。 更稳、完全不依赖 Node 的写法：先装脚本（方式一），再指向本机 Py

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-map

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

DSH skill map: browse every loaded skill through your own categories in a right-sidebar tab, and rename, add, delete, reorder or re-file them in place.

## What it does

- Contributes one tab to the right sidebar, through the public service the right sidebar exposes to other plugins.
- Shows the loaded skills as categories: a caret, a category name and a count, collapsed by default. A skill row is one line; its description unfolds on hover, and while a search is filtering.
- Searches skill names and descriptions, and expands or collapses every category at once.
- Switches the description language from the panel's own settings view (the gear in the header): the skill's own text, or any translation cache kept at `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/descriptions.<lang>.json`. A skill with no row in that cache keeps its own text.
- Creates, renames and deletes categories from the panel, and reorders them by dragging.
- Moves a skill between categories, or back to Unassigned, by dragging it onto the target category.
- Copies `/skill-name` when a skill row is clicked, ready for the composer.
- Keeps the map in a user-owned file, so the categories outlive the plugin version.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kissfire/dsh-skill-map
```

Every release also ships the built package as a tarball on [Releases](https://github.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/releases) — same content, no build step (bump the tag in the URL for later releases):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/releases/download/v0.1.0/kissfire-dsh-skill-map-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart `dsh web`, or toggle the plugin's row in the plugin manager, then open the map tab in the right sidebar. The tab needs a right sidebar that exposes its plugin service; without one (no `dsh-better-sidebar` in the profile) the plugin stays installed and simply contributes no surface.

## Config

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Master switch for the host routes. |
| `customSkillDirs` | string[] | Extra skill roots to scan besides the official ones. |
| `dshHome` | string | DSH home override; the map file lives under it. |
| `agentsHome` | string | Agents home override (`~/.agents`). |

## Routes

| Route | Method | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/list` | GET | Inventory grouped by the user map; accepts an optional `?cwd=`. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/save` | POST | Writes the whole user map (categories plus placements). |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/health` | GET | Health check carrying the skill and category counts. |

## Security model

- Every route sits behind the family trust fence: a loopback socket plus a loopback Host header, or a live paired-device cookie when `dsh-remote-web-ui` is loaded. An unpaired LAN client gets `403 forbidden: loopback-only` before any file is read.
- Skill roots are read-only for this plugin. The only file it writes is its own map file under the DSH home directory.
- The save route validates placements against a fresh inventory pass, so a request cannot describe a skill this host does not serve; unknown names are dropped and counted in the response.
- The map file is written atomically and parsed defensively, so a truncated or hand-edited file falls back to the shipped categories instead of breaking the panel.

## Known limitations

- The tab needs a right sidebar that exposes the plugin service; a profile without one leaves the plugin with no surface at all.
- Categories are flat: there is no nesting and no per-skill note.
- A placement for an uninstalled skill is dropped on the next save rather than kept as a placeholder.
- The shipped categories are a one-time seed; after the first open the panel never rewrites them from the package.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

## Release

```sh
pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
# bump "version" in package.json
pnpm publish:npm
```

Updates reach users through npm: the market compares the published version with the installed one, so shipping code never needs a pull request. Only a change to this plugin's catalogue entry (description, category, repository URL) needs a PR to [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin); screenshots come from `screenshots.json` in this repository and are picked up nightly.

## Telemetry

The browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day to dsh-market.com: a random localStorage id and this package name, nothing else. Implementation: [src/client/telemetry.ts](src/client/telemetry.ts).

## License

BSD-3-Clause.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-hub — a GitHub plugin hub for DeepSeek Harness

A native DSH panel (host half + browser half) that signs in to your GitHub account, keeps a
sign-in history, searches GitHub / npm for `deepseek-harness` (`dsh-plugin`) plugins, and installs
them into the current profile with one click — through exactly the same path as
**Settings → Plugins** and `dsh plugin add`.

Chinese documentation: [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

---

## What it adds

* **Discover** — search GitHub repositories (`topic:dsh-plugin`, `topic:deepseek-harness`,
  `dsh-plugin in:name,description,readme`, …) or npm packages (`keywords:dsh-plugin`).
  *Inspect* reads the repository's `package.json` and tells you whether it really is an
  installable DSH plugin (does it declare `dsh.bundle.patch`? does it ship a `dsh.client` half?).
  *Install* runs the profile's own pnpm path with a live log, cancel support, and an
  "allow the blocked build scripts and retry" button when pnpm withholds lifecycle scripts.
* **Installed** — the profile's bundles and plugin rows, with enable / disable / remove,
  load errors and read-only reasons.
* **Account** — sign in with a **Personal Access Token** or **OAuth Device Flow**
  (bring your own OAuth App `client_id`; no client secret needed). Sign-in / sign-out history
  is persisted and can be cleared.
* **Diagnostics** — a connectivity report for the GitHub API, npm, DNS, the hosts file, `git`
  and `pnpm`, plus which rung of the TLS trust ladder the current requests use.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-github-hub
# local development
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-github-hub
```

Then **restart the desktop app** — reloading the page is not enough, because DSH collects its boot
injection table once per host start, and a new plugin's client bundle only enters that manifest on
the next start (the web profile needs its `dsh web` process restarted for the same reason).
A **git-branch icon** then appears in the left sidebar and opens the panel in the central area.

## Read-only endpoints

Beyond the panel, the host half exposes a few read-only endpoints for troubleshooting (all require
the browser session cookie):

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-github/state` | account, settings, sign-in history, trust ladder, client-bundle graph state |
| `GET /dsh-github/health` | GitHub API, npm, DNS, hosts, git, pnpm checks plus plain-language notes |
| `GET /dsh-github/client` | the graph `rev` and real URL of the client bundle, next to the `rev` computed from the file on disk (a mismatch means edits are not loaded yet) |
| `GET /dsh-github/search?source=github\|npm&q=…` | search |
| `POST /dsh-github/repo/package` | read a repository's `package.json` and judge it |
| `POST /dsh-github/inspect` | pre-flight one spec through the real plugin manager (performs the GitHub connection check, installs nothing) |

## Verified on this machine

* the GitHub API is reachable through the local accelerator at `tls=default` (144 system roots were
  merged into the process default chain at startup), so no insecure rung was needed;
* `pnpm add github:<owner>/<repo>` and `pnpm add git+https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git` both
  fetch and link a real package (37s and 19s, peer dependencies included);
* the official pipeline `pluginManager.installBundle` completed end to end for a `link:` spec
  (pnpm log events → progress polling → bundle activation);
* `POST /inspect` on `github:<owner>/<repo>` returns `{status:'accepted', kind:'git', host:'github.com'}`;
* the fences hold: authenticated 200, no cookie 401, `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 403.

## Signing in

* **Token (recommended)** — create one at <https://github.com/settings/tokens> with `read:user`
  (add `repo` for private repositories) and paste it into the panel.
  It is stored in the DSH credential service as the record `dsh-github-hub/github`
  (kind `grant`) and is **never** sent to the page; the UI only shows login, avatar, scopes and
  the last four characters.
* **Device flow** — create an OAuth App (no client secret required), paste its `client_id`,
  start the flow, enter the one-time code at <https://github.com/login/device>.

## Data

| Item | Location |
|---|---|
| GitHub token | DSH credential service (record `dsh-github-hub/github`) |
| Settings + sign-in history | `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-github-hub.json` (no token, max 200 entries) |
| Install logs | `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/.plugin-manager/logs/operation-*/pnpm.log` |

All endpoints live under `ctx.webServer` at `/dsh-github/*` behind three fences: loopback (or
explicitly trusted) Host, no cross-site requests, and write requests accepted only from the
local machine.

## GitHub behind a local interceptor

Accelerators such as Watt Toolkit / Steam++ rewrite `github.com`, `api.github.com` and
`raw.githubusercontent.com` to `127.0.0.1` and re-serve them through a local reverse proxy with
its own CA, which Node does not trust by default (`unable to verify the first certificate`).
This plugin walks a trust ladder instead of failing:

1. default trust chain;
2. default roots **plus** the operating system root store (equivalent to `node --use-system-ca`);
3. trust the local interceptor — only when the peer genuinely resolves to loopback **and** the
   setting is enabled, and the UI always reports `tls: local-interceptor` when it happens.

Installing from GitHub uses pnpm's `github:owner/repo` (git) transport, so **`git` must be on
PATH**; the plugin manager performs a bounded connection check before pnpm starts.

## Known limits

* A freshly installed plugin usually still needs an app restart (or page reload) before its
  sidebar icon appears — DSH collects the index injection table once at startup.
* Installing a third-party plugin executes third-party host code inside your DSH process.
  The panel shows repository metadata and the `package.json` verdict, but does not audit code.
* Removing a bundle does not delete data files the third-party plugin wrote under `$DSH_HOME`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

安装 本包是一个标准的 DSH **profile bundle**（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）， 所以官方途径和手动兜底都行。 ### 方式一：官方命令（推荐） ```bash # 普通（dsh web / 非桌面版）——把 换成你的 profile 名，通常是 web 或 default dsh plugin --profile add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` **Desktop（桌面版应用）用户注意**：桌面版把自己的 `desktop` profile 锁给了 Electron 进程， 直接用全局 `dsh` 会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。 请改用桌面版自带的 CLI，或干脆用 GUI： ```powershell # Windows： 换成你装 DeepSeek Harness 的地方 & "\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` 或者：打开 DSH 界面 → 侧栏**插件** → 添加插件 → 把包名/URL 粘进去。 > `github:` 这种写法需要机器上有 **git**（DSH 会先 `git ls-remote` 探一下）。 > 没装 git 的话，用下面的 tarball 写法或方式二。 **不想装 git？用 Release 里的 tgz**（`dsh plugin` 支持 tarball URL，不需要 git）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-sylphiette-agent-1.0.1.tgz ``` ### 方式二：兜底脚本（不碰 pnpm、不需要 git、不需要 DSH CLI） 适合桌面版用户，或者在官方途径上卡住的时候： ```bash # 先把仓库下载/克隆到本地，进入包根目录，然后： node bin/install.mjs # 先预览，什么都不改 node bin/install.mjs --apply # 真正安装 ``` 它会： 1. 把整包拷到 `/dsh-sylphiette-agent/`（默认 `~/.dsh`，Windows 是 `C:\Users\你\.dsh`） 2. 把包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明内联进 `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`， 并把插件路径转成绝对 `file://` URL 3. 备份原来的 patch，然后逐项验证 可选参数：`--home `、`--profile <名字>`、`--patch <文件>`、`--uninstall --apply`。 自动探测失败时先加 `--home` 指明位置。 ### 装完之后 —— 必须重启一次 ⚠️ **装完请重启 DeepSeek Harness**（桌面版关掉再打开；`dsh web` 用户重启那个进程）。 实测结论：**新装的 bundle 不会被 HMR 自动加载**。装完立刻看是看不到「希露菲」的——组合产物 （`profiles//cordis.yml`）里也不会有它，因为那份配置是在装包**之前**就组合好的。 重启后配置重新组合，希露菲才会出现在预设列表里。 重启后：新建会话 → Agent 预设 选「希露菲」。 ### v1.0.1 修了什么 v1.0.0 里插件行写的是相对路径 `./lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs`，那是错的： DSH 的 `anchorInsertedPluginNames` 只转换 patch `insert` **本层**的 name（以及 `group.config` 那种形式）， **不会递归进 preset 行 `config.plugins` 里的嵌套插件行**。于是这个相对名被当作相对 **profile 目录**解析 （`profiles/

# dsh-session-tool

会话太多删不掉？归档只是隐藏、记录还躺在磁盘上？想给一个会话换个名字还要翻菜单？

**给 DSH 补上会话管理：侧栏「⋯」菜单一键删除（永久删除、可配置），对话区头部一键重命名。**

> ⚠️ **删除是永久删除，不可恢复**（本插件没有回收站）。删除**正在运行**的会话时，会**先停止该会话，然后再删除**。

![界面示意](docs/preview.png)

## 安装

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-tool

# 本地目录
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-tool

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-session-tool
```

装完**重启 DSH**。`<profile>` 替换成你的 profile 名（如 `web`、`desktop`）。

## 功能

- **⋯ 菜单「删除会话」**：文案、顺序、显隐、红色危险样式、禁用态都可配置
- **头部「重命名会话」✏️**：走官方 `sessions` 服务，改完侧栏与头部标题即时更新
- **一次确认**：勾选「我已了解后果」才能点删除（未勾选时按钮禁用）
- **永久删除 + 先停止**：运行中的会话先 `cancel` 并等静默（最多 15 秒），再 flush/detach，最后删除目录并清理记账
- **官方悬停按钮可隐藏**：归档 / 置顶两个图标按钮（只支持 `hidden`）
- **审计日志**：配置问题与每一次删除都写 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`

## 配置

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`），**键名区分大小写**，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。
**只写你要改的部分**，没写的键全部用默认值。

### 完整 schema

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # ⋯ 菜单里的项
      official:                    # 官方 4 项（不写 = 一个都不碰）
        pin:     { }               # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename:  { }               # 只支持 hidden（重命名对话框是官方内部实现）
        fork:    { }               # 可写：label / order / hidden
        archive: { }               # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin:
        delete:
          label: "删除会话"         # 文案（留空 = 跟随系统语言）
          order: 500               # 顺序，越小越靠前
          hidden: false            # true = 隐藏这一项
          danger: true             # 红色危险样式
          disabled: false          # 禁用态：变灰、点不动
          shortcut: null           # 【已登记，本阶段未实现】
          separatorBefore: false   # 【已登记，本阶段未实现】
    ButtonItems:                   # 会话行悬停时的图标按钮
      official:
        archive: { hidden: false } # 只支持 hidden
        pin:     { hidden: false } # 只支持 hidden（已归档的行上本来也不显示）
      plugin: { }                  # 占位：本插件不提供悬停按钮
```

### order 参考值

`order` 是普通数字，**升序排列**：越小越靠前；**不写等于 0**（会排在最前面）；数字相同则按注册顺序（官方先注册，排在我们前面）。

| order | 菜单项 | 来源 | 能否修改 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 置顶会话 `pin` | 官方 | label / activeLabel / order / hidden |
| 200 | 重命名 `rename` | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |
| 300 | 分叉会话 `fork` | 官方 | label / order / hidden |
| 400 | 归档会话 `archive` | 官方 | label / activeLabel / order / hidden |
| 500 | 删除会话 `delete` | 本插件（默认） | 全部字段 |

| order | 悬停按钮 | 来源 | 能否修改 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 归档按钮 | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |
| 200 | 置顶按钮 | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |

### 我的配置（实际在用的）

```yaml
# order 参考：官方 pin 100 / rename 200 / fork 300 / archive 400；本插件 delete 默认 500
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # ⋯ 菜单里的项
      official:                    # 官方 4 项：不写就不碰
        pin: {}                    # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename: {}                 # 只支持 hidden
        fork: {}                   # 可写：label / order / hidden
        archive: {}                # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin:
        delete:                    # 本插件唯一的菜单项
          label: "删除会话"
          order: 500
          hidden: false
          danger: true             # 红色危险样式
          disabled: false          # 禁用态（变灰、点不动）
    ButtonItems:                   # 会话行【悬停时】的图标按钮
      official:
        archive:
          hidden: true             # 隐藏官方悬停「归档」按钮
        pin:
          hidden: true             # 隐藏官方悬停「置顶」按钮
      plugin: {}                   # 占位：本插件不提供悬停按钮
```

## 界面

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧栏会话行「⋯」菜单 | 「删除会话」（文案/顺序/显隐/危险样式/禁用态可配） |
| 对话区头部工具栏 | ✏️「重命名会话」（该排最左侧） |
| 会话行悬停区 | 官方归档/置顶按钮（可隐藏）；本插件不提供悬停按钮 |

**删除弹窗四态**

| 状态 | 触发 | 表现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 正常 | 会话在列表且未运行 | 副标题「删除后，该对话将不可恢复」+ 勾选框 + 删除按钮（未勾选时禁用） |
| 运行中 | 会话正在运行 | 多一行 ⚠「会话正在运行 —— 删除会立即中断它正在进行的任务」，勾选框与按钮变成「停止并删除」 |
| 会话不存在 | 列表里找不到该会话 | 提示刷新后重试，隐藏勾选框、禁用删除按钮 |
| 删除成功 | 删除完成 | 「已删除」+「该对话已永久删除，无法恢复。」+ 完成按钮 |

**重命名**：输入框预填当前名称、自动聚焦；名称为空时「确定」禁用；回车提交、Esc 取消；失败在弹窗内显示原因。

## 实现说明

**删除链路**（六步）

1. 界面校验：回环地址 + 同源请求（其他来源 403，方法不对 405）
2. 运行中的会话：`cancel` 取消回合并等待静默（最多 15 秒）
3. `flush` 写盘 + 从内存会话表 `detach`，避免收尾阶段把日志目录重建回来
4. **删除磁盘目录**（收尾再扫一遍）—— 这一步是永久删除，文件不进入任何回收目录
5. 清理记账：投影缓存行、投影缓存文件、工作区 `sessionIds`、归档集合
6. 写审计日志

**加载稳健性**

- 客户端 `apply` **必须同步完成**：任何 `await`（尤其是网络请求）都可能让入口永远停在 `loading`
- 界面配置在后台读取（3 秒超时、失败重试 5 次 × 2 秒），到达后自动重建注册；读不到就用默认值
- 宿主的三条 HTTP 路由按**进程级单例**注册（同进程重复加载时复用，不撞 `duplicate exact route`）

**官方悬停按钮的隐藏是怎么实现的（维护提示）**

插槽契约写着「复用官方 id 就会替换那一行」，但实测**跨插件不可靠**：框架给每个插件各自分配注册优先级，
官方注册的条目数量多、计数更靠前，于是官方那行仍然胜出。所以本插件改用 **DOM/CSS 级隐藏**：

```html
<style id="dsh-session-tool-hide-shipped">
  button[aria-label="归档会话"],button[aria-label="取消归档"],
  button[aria-label="Archive session"],button[aria-label="Unarchive session"],
  button[aria-label="置顶会话"],button[aria-label="取消置顶"],
  button[aria-label="Pin session"],button[aria-label="Unpin session"] { display: none !important; }
</style>
```

> ⚠️ **维护提示**：这段选择器依赖官方按钮的 `aria-label` 文案（中英各 2 种状态，共 8 条）。
> 如果 DSH 更新后官方改了这些文案（或新增状态），隐藏会失效 —— 此时只需在 `lib/client.js` 的
> `ARCHIVE_LABELS` / `PIN_LABELS` 两个数组里补上新文案即可。日志里每次加载都会记录 `cssRules=<条数>`，可用来核对。

## 日志

`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`（超过 1 MB 轮转为 `.log.1`）

```
[2026-10-16T09:08:44.519Z] delete ok     id=session-9cc49402-…  title="创建三个空子智能（9cc49402）"  running=false  stopped=false  dirs=1  elapsed=0.0s
[...] plugin info   HTTP 路由已注册：/list /config /diag /delete
[...] config warn   未知的配置键 "menuItems" → 你是否想写 "MenuItems"？（键名区分大小写）
[...] client info   config #1: ok | changed=true | hiddenButtons=archive,pin | cssRules=8
```

配置写错**不会**打断 DSH 启动，只会记一行日志并忽略该项。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-tool
```

## 更新日志

完整版本记录见 [`changelog/CHANGELOG.md`](changelog/CHANGELOG.md)。

# dsh-session-tool

Too many sessions and no way to remove them? Archiving only hides a session while its files stay on disk? Renaming a session means digging through menus?

**Session management for DSH: delete from the sidebar "..." menu (permanent, configurable) and rename from the conversation header.**

> ⚠️ **Deletion is permanent and unrecoverable** (there is no trash). Deleting a **running** session first stops it, then removes it.

![UI overview](docs/preview.png)

## Installation

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-tool

# local checkout
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-tool

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-session-tool
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Replace `<profile>` with your profile name (e.g. `web`, `desktop`).

## Features

- **"..." menu item "Delete session"**: label, order, visibility, danger styling and disabled state are all configurable
- **Header "Rename session"** (pencil): uses the official `sessions` service, so the sidebar and header titles update live
- **Single confirmation**: the delete button stays disabled until "I understand the consequences" is ticked
- **Permanent delete, stop-first**: a running session is cancelled and awaited (up to 15 s), flushed and detached, then its directories are removed and the accounting is cleaned
- **Official hover buttons can be hidden**: the archive and pin icons (only `hidden` is supported)
- **Audit log**: configuration problems and every deletion are written to `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`

## Configuration

Put it in the profile patch file `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`. **Keys are case-sensitive** and changes apply after **restarting DSH**.
**Only write what you want to change** - everything omitted keeps its default.

### Full schema

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # items in the "..." menu
      official:                    # the 4 shipped items (omitting one leaves it untouched)
        pin:     { }               # writable: label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename:  { }               # hidden only (its dialog is official internals)
        fork:    { }               # writable: label / order / hidden
        archive: { }               # writable: label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin

DeepSeek Harness 扫榜插件：定时 + 按需采集多站小说榜单，算变化，在一个面板里挑着看。
只读站点公开榜单与书页 —— 不登录、不抓正文、不推送；全部数据留在本地数据目录。

> **本插件不注册任何 DSH 工具**。对外能力只有两样：面板 UI（左侧栏「扫榜」入口 + 浮窗）与同源 HTTP 路由 `/api/rank-scan/*`。
> 装配入口是 `cordis.patch.yml`（由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向）。

## 安装 / 更新

两条路任选一条。**两条都要求先完全退出 DSH 桌面版** —— 这是宿主自己的规矩（profile 由桌面应用独占管理），不是本插件的要求，也不需要重启电脑。装完重开 DSH 即可。

### 一、从仓库链接直装（不用先下载文件）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan
# 想钉版本：github:kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan#v0.2.1
```

- 安装时会**现场从源码构建**：仓库不含编译产物，靠 `package.json` 的 `prepare` 在安装时跑 `scripts/build.mjs` 生成 `lib/`。
- pnpm 默认拦截依赖的构建脚本，首次会失败 —— `dsh` 会打印需要放行的确切键，把它加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 下，再重跑同一条命令即可。
- 需要你的机器上有 git、pnpm 与网络。

### 二、装 Release 附件（离线可用）

**第 1 步**：从 [Releases](https://github.com/kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan/releases) 下载最新的 `*.tgz`。
**第 2 步**：**完全退出 DSH 桌面版**，然后：

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts\install.ps1 -Spec "<刚下载的 tgz 的完整路径>"
```

macOS / Linux：`bash scripts/install.sh desktop <tgz 路径>`。

想自己从源码构建、或了解为什么仓库里不放 `lib/`，见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。

**验证**：重开 DSH 后左侧栏会话列表下方应出现「扫榜」入口；或访问 `http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/rank-scan/health`，返回 `{ok:true,...}` 即通。

**更新**：重跑上面任一条安装命令即可（链接直装会取最新 main）。装了 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 的话，面板「抓什么」页底部有版本区，可就地检查并一键更新（该路径以 npm 上的包为目标）。

**卸载**：`pwsh -File scripts\uninstall.ps1`（macOS / Linux：`bash scripts/uninstall.sh`）。卸载会清掉插件、路由残留与 junction，但**保留数据目录** —— 想彻底清理请自行删除它。

## 能做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 五站采集 | **起点**签约榜 × 15 分类（默认轻小说；其余分类勾了才抓，移动端口径）· **起点图**首订榜 / 三江·推荐效果（周）· **刺猬猫**点击榜(周) / 新书榜(周) / 首订(约) · **番茄**男频新书榜 × 8 分类 · **菠萝包**新书榜(点击) / 轻小说热榜(周) / VIP 热销榜(周) |
| 派生榜 | 番茄「在读周榜（候选池内）」由已落盘快照本地计算，**不发请求**；不足 7 天标 `N/7` |
| 变化集 | 新入榜 / 回榜 / 上升 / 下降 / 退榜分开列；在榜天数；基准日；无基准时一律「—」，**不报 0** |
| 周期榜换期 | 起点图三江当期无数据自动回退上一期（最多 2 期）；**换期当天变化列判不可比**并标注「新期」 |
| 状态五态 | `ok` / `missing` / `stale` / `login_required` / `truncated`；**缺失一律 `null`，绝不补 0** |
| 按需补全 | 起点精确字数与收藏、番茄干净书名/作者、刺猬猫与菠萝包字数与收藏；结果就地覆盖当天快照，可重复补（幂等） |
| 落盘纪律 | 按数据日期落快照，原子写、同日覆盖即幂等；精简索引 / 保留清理 / 导出 |
| 定时扫描 | 按站分时，**默认开启**，安装当天不跑；面板可改时刻与开关，**改动跨重载保留** |
| 面板记忆 | 浮窗位置与尺寸、收起状态、当前页签、正在看哪天，都在刷新后恢复 |
| 版本与更新 | 面板显示当前版本；装了 dsh-market 可一键更新，没装则只读（不硬赌能力） |
| 防卡死 | 单请求 15s / 单榜 90s / 单站连败 3 次熔断 / 120s 无进展看门狗 / 扫描锁 + 心跳（心跳过期可接管） |
| 书签 | 面板内收藏作品、备注夹、回收站、导出 |

## 用法

### 面板（四个页签）

| 页签 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| **概览** | 一行汇总（数据日期 / 基期 / 榜数 / 异常数 / 隐藏数 / 上次扫描）+ 按站分组的单表；异常榜折叠；下方接「今天的变化」 |
| **当前榜单** | 站 → 榜 → 日期 → 排序四级控件；「每榜取 N 条」；点任意一行展开行内详情卡（书名/作者/字数/更新时间 + 在站点打开 + 复制链接） |
| **我的书签** | 卡片列表 + 搜索 / 按站与备注夹过滤 + 备注编辑 + 回收站 + 手动添加 + 导出 |
| **抓什么** | 站 → 榜种 → 分类勾选（**改了先点保存**，下次扫描生效）+ 按站时刻与定时开关 + 版本区 |

浮窗标题栏可拖动、右下角把手可缩放，位置与尺寸本地记忆。面板改完客户端记得**刷新页面**（客户端 bundle 由页面加载）。

### 定时扫描

- **默认开启**，但**安装当天不自动跑**（次日按时刻跑）；面板「抓什么」页可关掉或改时刻，关掉后重载仍保留。
- 按站分时：每个站可以有自己的抓取时刻，兜底时刻 22:30。
- 同一时刻只有一轮扫描（定时与手动共用一把锁，冲突时手动请求返回 409）。
- 诊断日志：`<dataDir>/state/timer.log`（接线 / 迁移 / 每轮开始结束各一行）。

### HTTP 路由（同源、只读本地快照，渲染不联网）

| 路由 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/rank-scan/health` | 自检：路由是否挂上（端口 / 数据目录 / 数据日期列表） |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/overview` | 概览：数据日期 / 基准日 / 五态计数 / 隐藏榜数 / 每站每榜状态与涨新退 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/board?boardId=&date=&sort=` | 当前榜单：列随榜、缺失显示「—」、当天无快照时回落最近可用并标注日期 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/changes` | 今天的变化：按站编组，组内固定 新入榜/回榜/上升/下降/退榜 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/catalog` | 可选榜清单：站 → 榜种 → 分类 + 是否已勾选 + 各榜深度 + 定时状态 |
| `POST /api/rank-scan/scan` `cancel` `retry` | 立刻扫一次（可带 `{boards}` 只扫指定榜）/ 取消 / 只重跑当天非 ok 的榜 |
| `POST /api/rank-scan/select` `depth` `timer` | 抓取集与显示集 / 每榜取数（1–100）/ 定时开关与时刻 |
| `POST /api/rank-scan/enrich?boardId=` `enrich-all` | 按需补全某榜或抓取集内全部分类榜的字段 |
| `GET/POST /api/rank-scan/bookmarks` `bookmark` `bookmark/sync` `bookmark/export` `bookmark/trash` | 书签列表 / 单条增删改 / 同步 / 导出 / 回收站 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/version` `update-check`，`POST /api/rank-scan/update` `update-restart` | 版本读数与一键更新（只走 dsh-market 公开的更新 API v1；宿主不支持重启时明确拒绝并提示自行重启） |

跨源请求一律 403：`/api/rank-scan/*` 在宿主侧不做鉴权，插件自己加了来源闸。

## 数据与隐私

- **只读**站点公开榜单与书页；**不登录、不抓正文、不推送**任何地方。
- 采集纪律：限速 **1s/请求**、每榜**每日 1 次**、失败重试 **≤2** 次。
- 数据目录默认 `~/.dsh/data/rank-scan/`（插件配置 `dataDir` 可改）：

```text
<dataDir>/<数据日期>/<boardId>.json   快照（rows + metric）
<dataDir>/<数据日期>/scan.json        本次扫描元信息（attempt / outcome / progress / 每榜状态）
<dataDir>/state/scan.lock.json        扫描锁（含心跳时间）
<dataDir>/state/retries.json          各榜当日重试次数
<dataDir>/state/cancel.json           取消标志
<dataDir>/state/timer.log             定时诊断
<dataDir>/state/qidian-book-cache.json 起点书页缓存（TTL 内不重复下载）
<dataDir>/font-map.json               番茄字体映射（私用区码点 → 真字）
```

数据只在本地，插件不写工作区内任何文件。

## 排障

**左侧栏没有「扫榜」入口**（按顺序看）：

1. DSH 启动日志里搜 `did not activate` 与 `pending (waiting for services`：前者 = 面板 bundle 没加载成功，后者 = 缺 timer / webServer 服务；
2. 访问 `/api/rank-scan/health`：能返回 JSON ⇒ host 侧活着，问题在面板；连不上 ⇒ 插件没装上；
3. 重装一次：`pwsh -File scripts\install.ps1 -Spec "<tgz>"`。

**面板点不开 / 点了没反应**：先确认点的是哪颗按钮 —— DSH 的侧栏会把插件入口包进它自己的一行 `<button>`，我们的入口嵌在里面（DOM 里因此有两颗文本相同的 button，外层那颗不是我们的 handler）。

**某个榜显示 `missing` / 一列都是「—」**：先看是不是数据源本身就没有这个字段（例如站点榜单页不给字数与收藏，需要点「补全」进书页取）；本插件对缺失一律显示「—」，不会编造 0。

**站点改版**：先跑夹具测试（`node tests/qidian-fixture.test.mjs` 等），再看 `tests/fixtures/` 里的响应快照哪里变了。

## 开发

构建、测试、设计约束、目录结构、面板与宿主路由结构、验收闸门与依赖纪律，见 **[docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)**；版本变更历史见 **[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)**。

## 许可证

BSD-3-Clause，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.
